All at no cost to you!"'' :{{ESO BW}}''"The crafters of Leyawiin bids you welcome! Masters of the craft await you in Leyawiin! New crafters shall be trained! Accomplished crafters will be certified! All at no cost to you!"'' :{{ESO HI}}''"The people of the Systres Isles bid you welcome! Masters of the craft await you in Gonfalon Bay! New crafters shall be trained! Accomplished crafters will be certified! All at no cost to you!"'' :{{ESO NE}}(Same as alliance message) *{{Quest Link|Blacksmith Writ}} *{{Quest Link|Clothier Writ}} *{{Quest Link|Jewelry Crafting Writ}} *{{Quest Link|Woodworker Writ}} ===Crafting Survey Reports=== The rewards for fulfilling crafting writs, except Provisioner writs, may randomly include [[Online:Survey Reports|Survey Reports]], which are similar to Treasure Maps. When you receive one, a collection of six high-yield gathering nodes are added to a specific location, identified by the symbol on the map. These high-yield nodes do not appear unless you have the corresponding survey. It is possible to be rewarded with the same report multiple times. If this occurs, the nodes will respawn after you move a distance away, and the materials may change for alchemy and enchanting surveys. The tier of materials at the survey location will be determined by both the level of the character and the skill in the appropriate crafting line (with the exception of alchemy), with 50% of the materials being at each. If the character level and skill level match, all materials will be of the same crafting tier. Surveys have an approximate 1 in 8 chance of dropping, regardless of level of crafting writ completed. Surveys will drop as an "Unidentified" report of the appropriate craft, and will stack. In the unidentified form, surveys are able to be sold at guild stores as well as deposited into guild banks. When you open the unidentified report, you can receive surveys for any zone, including zones you have never visited, though you will not receive surveys for zones you do not have access to. Once opened, the surveys are account bound. Surveys are able to be put into the player bank, and they will stack, unlike treasure maps. Provisioners do not receive survey reports, and instead receive a [[Online:Recipes|Recipe]] when they turn in writs, corresponding to their Recipe Improvement level. ==Master Writs== Master writs are special writs that can be rewarded to you after completing a normal top-tier writ. These are sealed requests that require you to create a master item, for example a {{Item Link|quality=e|Sealed Alchemy Writ|id=119820}}. Unlike regular writs, the requested master item can be of purple or gold quality, include a trait and may require rare ingredients or components. Arms or armor writs typically ask for the piece to be crafted in a specific [[ON:Craftable Sets|craftable set]]. Crafting such items require special crafting stations that can only be found at [[ON:Crafting Sites|Crafting Sites]] across the world, or having access to an appropriately attuned crafting station in a player home. They also require the items to be crafted in a specific style; the style must be learned and the style material acquired. Once master writs are accepted, they are entered into your journal as quests and the writ item disappears from your inventory. Care should be taken before accepting a master writ quest to make sure you have the skills, researched traits or any other requirements to complete it. Only one type of master writ quest can be accepted at any one time, and they cannot be abandoned and re-accepted like other quests. There is no daily limit or cooldown on Master Writs. Below is a list of each possible quest: {| class="wikitable sortable" !Profession!!Quest Name |- !Alchemy |{{Quest Link|A Masterful Concoction}} |- !Blacksmithing |{{Quest Link|A Masterful Plate}}
{{Quest Link|A Masterful Weapon (Blacksmithing)}} |- !Clothing |{{Quest Link|Masterful Leatherwear}}
{{Quest Link|Masterful Tailoring}} |- !Enchanting |{{Quest Link|A Masterful Glyph}} |- !Jewelry Crafting |{{Quest Link|Masterful Jewelry}} |- !Provisioning |{{Quest Link|A Masterful Feast}} |- !Woodworking |{{Quest Link|A Masterful Shield}}
{{Quest Link|A Masterful Weapon (Woodworking)}} |} Completing a Master Writ will reward you with [[ON:Writ Vouchers|Writ Vouchers]], which can be used to buy special or unique items from [[Online:Rolis Hlaalu|Rolis Hlaalu]], the Mastercraft Mediator. Generally, the more complex and expensive the writ, the more vouchers you will receive. The lowest reward possible is {{ESO WV|2}} Writ Vouchers for a relatively simple and inexpensive alchemy potion. The highest reward can be several hundred Writ Vouchers for Jewelry writs, which themselves are extremely expensive to craft. Ultimately, low-reward alchemy and enchanting master writs can be more cost-effective to complete than high-reward armor, weapon and especially jewelry writs due to the cost of materials and tempers. Sealed Master Writs can be traded or transferred between characters, but the requested item itself must be crafted by the character that accepted the Master Writ quest. Requested items cannot be traded between characters to complete the quest. ===Factors Affecting Drop Rates=== The drop rate of master writs are affected by the knowledge level of the character that completes the daily crafting quests. For each of the crafts, the factors that affect the drop rates are: *Alchemy — Learning all 4 traits of the base game reagents. *Enchanting — Translate all base game runes. *Provisioning — Learning Epic (Purple) and Legendary (Gold) Recipes. *Blacksmithing/Clothing/Woodworking — Learning all 9 crafting traits for the appropriate craft. Learning as many complete motifs. Base game racial motifs do not count. Crown store exclusive motifs do not count. *Jewelry — Learning all 9 jewelry traits. The developers have stated that research traits and motif knowledge are "similarly weighted" in the calculation of master writs. Drop rates do not go down with the addition of new motifs to the game, but there are diminishing returns on learning more on a character. These only affect the chance of getting any master writ, not the quality. The quality of the master writ received is random. ===Event Writs=== During certain [[ON:Events|events]], special festival writs have a chance to drop from event loot boxes. Writ rewards can vary between {{ESO WV|1}} and {{ESO WV|20}} Writ Vouchers, making this an opportunity for players who cannot complete Master Writs to obtain vouchers. These do not count towards any non-event achievements such as [[Online:Grand Master Crafter|Grand Master Crafter]]. * {{Item Link|quality=s|Witches Festival Writs|id=153482}} — [[Online:Witches Festival Writs|Witches Festival Writs]] were available during the [[Online:Witches_Festival#Witches_Festival_2019|2019]] and [[Online:Witches_Festival#Witches_Festival_2020|2020 Witches Festival]] and required players to create Witches Festival themed food or drink. * {{Item Link|quality=s|New Life Charity Writs|id=145531}} — [[Online:New Life Charity Writs|New Life Charity Writs]] were available during the [[Online:New_Life_Festival#New_Life_Festival_2018|2018 New Life Festival]] and required players to create a dozen simple furnishings. * {{Item Link|id=156731|quality=s|Deep Winter Charity Writ}} — [[Online:Deep Winter Charity Writs|Deep Winter Charity Writs]] were available during the [[Online:New_Life_Festival#New_Life_Festival_2019|2019]] and [[Online:New_Life_Festival#New_Life_Festival_2020|2020 New Life Festivals]] and required players to create a dozen simple furnishings. * {{Item Link|Imperial Charity Writ|id=167169|quality=e}} — [[Online:Imperial Charity Writs|Imperial Charity Writs]] were available during the [[Online:New_Life_Festival#New_Life_Festival_2020|2020 New Life Festival]]. ==Notes== * Prior to [[ON:One Tamriel|One Tamriel]], writs could only be dropped off in specific cities, based on your alliance and rank in the associated crafting skill at the time of taking the writ. Surveys would always be given for the zone where you were dropping off your writs. The highest-level writs were dropped off in [[ON:The Hollow City|The Hollow City]], [[ON:Orsinium|Orsinium]], or [[ON:Belkarth|Belkarth]]. * Prior to Update 37, daily writs would reset at 6am UTC. {{Online Items}}

Online:Taunt:
{{Trail|Combat}}
{{About|The effect in combat|Scribing script|Taunt (script)}}
{{NeedsImage|A taunted enemy}}
'''Taunting''' is a combat tactic most commonly used by tank builds. It will cause the affected target to attack you instead of your allies. Although some can be completed without a tank, most of the game's 4-player [[ON:Grouping|group]] content is designed with taunting in mind. When one player has taunted an enemy, another player may not taunt them for 15 seconds afterwards. After 15 seconds, the taunt will wear off, which can be disastrous in certain boss battles. Generally speaking, if you are in a group and ''not'' playing the tank role, you should avoid using any kind of taunts.

There are a limited number of ways of taunting enemies. They include:
*The [[ON:Puncture|Puncture]] skill in the [[ON:One Hand and Shield|One Hand and Shield]] line. This only works from melee range, and requires you to be wielding a one-handed weapon and shield.
*The [[ON:Inner Fire|Inner Fire]] skill in the [[ON:Undaunted|Undaunted]] line. This method works from a distance, and lets you use the equipment of your choice.
*The [[ON:Destructive Clench|Destructive Clench]] skill with a Frost [[ON:Destruction Staff|Destruction Staff]] provides a ranged taunt and immobilizes the target.
*The [[ON:Runic_Jolt|Runic Jolt]] skill in the [[ON:Arcanist|Arcanist's]] [[ON:Soldier_of_Apocrypha|Soldier of Apocrypha]] line. Works from limited distance and can be morphed to steal armor or apply [[ON:Buffs#Lifesteal|Minor Lifesteal]].
*The [[ON:Chains of Flame|Chains of Flame]] skill in the [[ON:Dragonknight|Dragonknight's]] [[ON:Draconic Power|Draconic Power]] line. Pulls the enemy to you while taunting it. 
*The [[ON:Focused Charge|Focused Charge]] skill in the [[ON:Templar|Templar's]] [[ON:Aedric Spear|Aedric Spear]] line.
*The [[ON:Roar|Deafening Roar]] skill in the [[ON:Werewolf|Werewolf]] line causes Heavy Attacks to taunt while slotted.
*[[ON:Shield Throw|Shield Throw]] with the [[ON:Taunt (script)|Taunt]] Focus script. This requires you to be wielding a one-handed weapon and shield.
*[[ON:Vault|Vault]] with the [[ON:Taunt (script)|Taunt]] Focus script. This requires you to be wielding a bow. (Only one hit enemy is taunted)
*Using any [[ON:Charge|Charge]], Leap, Teleport, or Pull ability with the [[ON:Tormentor|Tormentor]] set. You'll need 5 pieces of this set, which only drops in [[ON:The Banished Cells|The Banished Cells]].
* Using any enemy targeted Pull ability on an enemy which does not have an active taunt. The Silver Leash morph of [[ON:Silver Bolts|Silver Bolts]] is an example of this ability.
*Blocking attacks with the [[ON:Swarm_Mother_(set)|Swarm Mother]] set. You'll need both pieces of this set, which drop from [[ON:Spindleclutch_I|Veteran Spindleclutch I]] and [[ON:Maj_al-Ragath|Maj al-Ragath's]] chest.
*During the final battle in [[ON:Arx Corinium|Arx Corinium]] against [[ON:Sellistrix the Lamia Queen|Sellistrix the Lamia Queen]], the Nereid sisters will give you the [[ON:Synergy|Synergy]]-like option to "Taunt Her!" If you're not playing the tank role, it's best to avoid using this.

There are also [[Category:Online-Sets_with_Taunt_Bonus|a number of sets]] which have a bonus effect that triggers when you taunt an enemy.
*The [[ON:Undaunted Bastion|Undaunted Bastion]] set will give you a [[ON:Damage Shield|Damage Shield]] when taunting enemies while you're below {{ESO Health Link|75%}}.

==Notes==
* Taunted enemies can either be tanked (i.e. attacks are absorbed) or kited (i.e. you stay out of attack range).
* Some enemies perform attacks which cannot be blocked. In situations like this, it's best for non-tanks to roll dodge to avoid these attacks.
* If an enemy is not taunted, it will usually attack the greatest damage threat.
* Bringing a taunted enemy outside its [[Online:Leashing|leash]] zone will reset the fight.
* Originally, it was possible for a single player to trigger an enemy's taunt immunity by applying it three times within 15 seconds. This is no longer the case, meaning taunts can be constantly applied if desired. This was replaced by "taunt immunity", whereby if three players attempted to taunt an enemy within a 12-second period, the enemy would briefly become immune to taunts. These penalties have since been relaxed to be more than five taunts between at least two players in the same 12-second period.

{{Trail|Combat}}

'''Execution''' is a tactic which is useful in longer battles, using skills and items which cause you to do more damage to enemies below a certain health threshold.  There are a number of both passive and active skills that help with executing targets at low health.  One useful strategy is to have your primary damage abilities on one tab and an execute skill on the other, and switch over when the target's health drops below the threshold.  Various addons exist which can alert you when the threshold has been passed.

Online:Weapon Critical (effect):
{{Trail|Combat}}
{{About|the effect in combat|effect in potions|ON:Weapon Critical}}
'''Weapon Critical''' is a value that represents your chance of performing a Critical Strike when attacking with a non-Staff weapon or ability with a {{ESO Stamina Link}} cost.  Your actual chance of performing such a strike also depends on your level - it is harder to strike critically the higher your level.  The formula{{Ref|name=formula|http://esoacademy.com/critical-strikes/#critical-strike-rating}} (all are identical - they are provided to aid ease of understanding) for determining the Maximum Critical Value (MCV) required to gain 100% Critical strike chance is:

  MCV = (2 * Level * (100 + Level))))
  MCV = (2*(100*Level + Level<sup>2</sup>))))
  MCV = (200*Level + 2*Level<sup>2</sup>))))

You start with a baseline 10% critical value, so the amount of Weapon Critical needed from buffs to get 100% Critical Strike Chance is 0.9 * MCV. This means at level 50 you need 13,500 Spell Critical to have a 100% chance (an extra 90%).  At CP160 (level 66) you need 19721 Spell Critical.  Your Critical Strike Chance% is then computed from:

  Critical Strike Chance% = min(100,10 + 100*(Critical Value / MCV))

You cannot have a worse than 10% chance (because 10% is your baseline) or better than 100% chance to critically strike.  So if you are CP160 and have a Weapon Critical of 3000, your Critical Strike Chance% = 10 + 100 * (3000 / 21912) = 23.7%

There are a large number of [[:Category:Online-Skills with Weapon Critical|skills]] and [[:Category:Online-Sets with Weapon/Spell Critical|sets]] which increase your Weapon Critical rating.  See those categories for a complete listing.  In addition, there are a few other ways of increasing your Weapon Critical rating:
*Successfully attacking while in [[ON:Stealth|Stealth]]
*Using a potion of [[ON:Weapon Critical|Weapon Critical]]
*Spending 20 [[ON:Champion|Champion]] points in the warfare constellation point, Precision. 
*[[ON:The Thief (Mundus Stone)|The Thief]] Mundus Stone

The [[ON:Critical Damage|Critical Damage]], or ''amount'' of increased damage or healing from Critical Strikes is normally 50% of the base strike. So at 50% chance, your strikes are 1.50x their defualt damage done, while at 100%, they are 2.0x and at 125% (which is maximum Critical Damage/Healing done) they are 2.25x.  Factors which increase your Weapon Critical Damage include:
*The Aggressive Horn morph of [[ON:War Horn|War Horn]]
*Several sets contain critical damage effects, including 5 piece sets like [[Online:Sul-Xan's Torment|Sul-Xan's Torment]] and mythics like [[Online:Harpooner's Wading Kilt|Harpooner's Wading Kilt]]
*Activating any [[ON:Synergy|Synergy]] cast by a player using the [[ON:Twilight Remedy|Twilight Remedy]] set
*Spending [[ON:Champion|Champion]] points on Fighting Finesse and Backstabber in the [[ON:Warfare|Warfare]] constellation
*[[ON:The Shadow (Mundus Stone)|The Shadow]] Mundus Stone

Online:Off Balance:
{{Trail|Combat}}
{{About|The effect in combat|Scribing script|Off Balance (script)}}
[[File:ON-misc-Offbalance.jpg|thumb|left|An Off Balance enemy]]
'''Off Balance''' is a debilitating effect in itself but it is mostly used to trigger other negative effects. It can be caused by various attacks, but most commonly by Blocking a melee Heavy Attack.

Applying Off Balance stuns the target. When an enemy is Off Balance, they can be knocked down with a Heavy Attack whose damage and resources restoration are boosted by 70%. Both the knockdown and the stun will not occur if the target is immune to crowd control but it will still be vulnerable to effects against Off Balance targets. You cannot get rid of Off Balance by breaking free of the crowd control or by using a cleansing ability.

Off Balance will last 7 seconds regardless of the source or the target and gives an Off Balance Immunity of 15 seconds when it ends.

Off Balance debuff icon: {{ESO Icon Abbr|misc|Off Balance}}

Off Balance Immunity icon: {{ESO Icon Abbr|achievement|Assassinate the Emperor}}

'''Immobilize''', also known as '''Root''', is a debilitating status effect that prevents a target from moving from their location, though they can still attack and defend themselves as normal. Many tougher enemies are immune to this effect.

Online:Leashing:
{{Trail|Combat}}
'''Leashing''' is a game mechanic which forces players to fight an enemy within a certain radius of their spawn location. In [[ON:Online|ESO]], most mobs are leashed to a specific area. Attempting to lead a mob out of this radius (such as by [[Online:Taunt|taunting]]) will cause them to cease combat and return to their starting position. When a mob ceases combat, it will restore to full health and become immune to all damage until it returns to its initial position. Such mobs won't engage in combat with any other players along the way.

Mobs will follow players for a short distance outside their leashing radius and continue to attack. This can prove dangerous, but a single attack will force them to cease combat. Once a player gets far enough away, the mobs will cease combat of their own accord. In addition to a leashing radius, instanced mobs may outright disappear and respawn if led outside the instanced area.

Leash mechanics are important to bear in mind if you plan to run past many mobs. This will result in a large following of hostile enemies, but most will give up pursuit when attacked after a certain distance. The mechanic may also prove disastrous if triggered during a [[Online:Bosses|boss]] fight, since it will reset the boss's health. For instance, the [[ON:Spawn of Mephala|Spawn of Mephala]] boss in [[Online:Fungal Grotto II|Fungal Grotto II]] has a small leashing radius to prevent exploits.

Some mobs, such as the [[ON:Patrolling Horrors|Patrolling Horrors]] in the [[ON:Imperial Districts|Imperial Districts]] and the [[ON:Coldharbour Elite Guard|Coldharbour Elite Guard]] in the [[ON:Imperial Sewers|Imperial City Sewers]], are not leashed and are therefore very difficult to escape from. These are known as '''[[Online:Sweepers|sweepers]]'''.
Online:Heavy Attack:
{{Trail|Combat}}
'''Heavy Attacks''' are attacks which must be charged. They do more damage per attack than light attacks, though less damage per second due to the charging time.  There may also be further effects. Using a heavy attack against an [[ON:Off Balance|Off Balance]] opponent will knock them down, deal 70% more damage and restore double the resources. Heavy attacks are performed by holding the attack button.

* Heavy attacks require no {{ESO Stamina Link}} or {{ESO Magicka Link}} but instead restore {{ESO Magicka Link}} (with staves) or {{ESO Stamina Link}} (other weapons) when fully charged.  The amount restored scales to the length of time that the heavy attack takes to charge, so for example, a heavy attack with a 2-handed weapon will restore more {{ESO Stamina Link}} than when dual wielding.  Based on [https://forums.elderscrollsonline.com/en/discussion/comment/7694093/#Comment_7694093 update 35 patch notes] heavy attacks restore 1350 of the appropriate resource and 2500 damage per second of their cast time, with ranged attacks doing 10% less damage.

* Restoration staves and Lightning staves will begin channeling damage as soon as the heavy attack begins. This can be a detriment if you don't want to catch the attention of an enemy until the attack is fully charged.  It can be a benefit since the attack will follow the enemy if they move during the channel, eliminating the need for you to track them until the attack is fully charged.

Online:Heavy Sack:
{{Trail|Crafting}}{{Incomplete|Needs comprehensive list of heavy sack/crate locations}}[[File:ON-node-Heavy Crate.jpg|thumb|left|A heavy crate]][[File:ON-node-Heavy Sack.jpg|thumb|right|A heavy sack]]{{TOCright}}
'''Heavy Sacks''' are lootable containers containing [[ON:Crafting|crafting]] [[ON:Crafting#Materials|materials]] which are found across [[ON:Tamriel|Tamriel]]. They are green sacks tied with a brown strip of leather, and are about knee-high. They are located in [[ON:Dungeons|dungeons]] and throughout the world in overland [[ON:Zones|zones]]. In the [[ON:Coldharbour|Coldharbour]] overland, Heavy Sacks are replaced by '''Heavy Crates''', which are identical in function.

When you loot a heavy sack, you'll gain a stack of ten raw materials for [[ON:Blacksmithing|blacksmithing]], [[ON:Tailoring|clothing]], [[ON:Woodworking|woodworking]] and [[ON:Jewelry Crafting|jewelry crafting]] materials. A haul containing raw materials from one of these professions may include ten samples of [[ON:Platinum|platinum]] dust. If you manage to loot [[ON:Enchanting|enchanting]] materials, you'll get two stacks of five runes. These stacks contain one type of rune each, and can contain [[ON:Runestones#Potency_Runes|Potency]], [[Online:Runestones#Essence_Runes|Essence]] or [[Online:Runestones#Aspect_Runes|Aspect Runes]]. For example: you may loot a heavy sack to receive five Dekeipa runes and five Notade runes. When you loot [[ON:Alchemy|alchemy]] ingredients, you will receive either five base-game reagents or ten potion solvents. An example of a haul featuring alchemy ingredients is a player receiving five [[ON:Bugloss|Bugloss]] or ten samples of [[ON:Lorkhan's Tears|Lorkhan's Tears]].

[[ON:Traits|Trait stones]] and [[ON:Style Materials|Style Materials]] for armor, jewelry and weapon crafting cannot be looted from heavy sacks. 

Heavy Crates can contain four alchemical reagents or ten raw crafting materials.

It can be used or sold to other players. Consuming it begins the quest [[Online: A Charitable Contribution (Imperial Charity)|A Charitable Contribution]]. ==Obtaining Writs== Imperial Charity Writs are obtained by opening {{Item Link|New Life Festival Boxes|id=156779|quality=2}}. These boxes are rewards from the New Life Festival Daily Quests. ==Crafting== When you open a writ, the following message is displayed. It will differ slightly depending on what the contract requires: :''Civilians displaced by the Three Banners War desperately need supplies as we resettle them throughout Tamriel.
Please make and deliver supplies ''[using/made by CraftSkill]'' to Selvari Abello at the New Life Festival camp. We appreciate the help.'' :'''''' ===Possible Requests=== The writ will have you craft one of the following provisioning or furnishings items: * {{Item Link|Chicken Breast|id=33819|quality=2}} (x12) * {{Item Link|Common Table, Slanted|id=118048|quality=2}} (x1) * {{Item Link|Roast Corn|id=33813|quality=2}} (x12) * {{Item Link|Grape Preserves|id=33825|quality=2}} (x12) * {{Item Link|Rough Bedroll, Basic|id=117963|quality=1}} (x3) * {{Item Link|Rough Bowl, Common|id=117943|quality=1}} (x3) * {{Item Link|Rough Cup, Empty|id=120410|quality=1}} (x3) Check out the [[Online: A Charitable Contribution (Imperial Charity)#Creating the Supplies|"Creating the Supplies"]] of the related quest walkthrough for skill and materials requirements for each possible contract. ==Reward== Upon completion of a writ, you will be rewarded with Inspiration, low amount of [[ON:Gold|leveled]] gold and experience, the allotted number of [[ON:Writ Vouchers|writ vouchers]], and a {{Item Link|Refugee's Gift|id=171332|quality=5}} that can be opened to reveal a [[Online:Rkindaleft Dwarven Style|Rkindaleft Dwarven Style]] Page which can be used or traded to others. Though, can anyone really argue the boost it gives one's dignity?"'' :'''Woodworking:''' ''"I used to think our people were like tempered steel, but I think we're more like an old tree. Sometimes it grows too big and falls over in the wind. Trees can always grow back, though, with stronger roots. Online:Penetration:
{{Trail|Combat}}
'''Penetration''' is a value that represents how much of your damage will break through an opponent's armor. The higher an enemy's armor, the more of your damage is mitigated. For example, if an enemy NPC has 18,200 armor, they will resist 36.4% of your damage. A higher amount of penetration means the more armor you will break through.

There are several ways to increase this:
* Passives, such as [[ON:Hunter's Eye|Hunter's Eye]] (Bosmer [[ON:Races|race]]), [[ON:Dismember|Dismember]] (Necromancer [[ON:Classes|class]]), [[ON:Concentration|Concentration]] (light [[ON:Armor|armor]]), and [[ON:Heavy Weapons|Heavy Weapons]] (two-handed [[ON:Weapons|weapon]] skill, specifically focused on mauls).
* [[ON:The Lover (Mundus Stone)|The Lover]] Mundus Stone.
* [[ON:Champion Points|Champion Point]] slottables, such as [[ON:Piercing|Piercing]] and [[ON:Force of Nature (champion)|Force of Nature]].
* Sets that contain Physical and Spell Penetration as part of the bonus, see [[:Category:Online-Sets with Physical/Spell Penetration|Category:Online-Sets with Physical Penetration]] and [[:Category:Online-Sets with Physical/Spell Penetration|Category:Online-Sets with Spell Penetration]]

Online:Swimming:
{{Trail|Combat}}__NOTOC__{{NeedsImage|A person swimming}}
'''Swimming''' is a type of movement done in water. While shallow water can simply be walked through, going through any water deeper than waist level will result in you swimming through it. Swimming in deeper or dangerous waters will cause you to slowly die to [[Online:Slaughterfish|Slaughterfish]].

There are some different types of liquids that can be swam through such as lava, which will cause you to burn to death, and the black ooze of [[ON:Apocrypha|Apocrypha]], which can kill you through [[ON:Traps#Abyssal Assault|Abyssal Assault]].

==Speed==
While Swimming, your [[Online:Movement Speed|movement speed]] is reduced to 60% of your regular walking speed. It can be increased to be a maximum of 120%.

===Methods of Increasing===
There are multiple ways to increase your speed while swimming, such as:
* [[Online:Amphibian|Amphibian]] passive
* Items that increase speed in general, such as the [[ON:Ring of the Wild Hunt|Ring of the Wild Hunt]]
* {{huh|More to add}}

==Mount Swimming==
Originally, [[Online:Mounts|mounts]] could not swim, and entering deep water would therefore force you to dismount. With [[Online:Update 47|Update 47]], animations were added for each variety of mount to ensure mounted travel is not disrupted when crossing bodies of water. It is still not possible to mount up while already swimming.

==Underwater Swimming==
[[File:ON-npc-Fractured Soul 02.jpg|thumb|left|An NPC swimming]][[File:ON-interior-Diving Portal.jpg|thumb|right|Walking on the seafloor inside the Diving Portal of Graven Deep]]
There are a select few locations such as [[ON:Graven Deep|Graven Deep]] and [[ON:Seaveil Spire|Seaveil Spire]] where one can technically swim underwater by travelling through a magic air bubble.

Online:Provisioning:
__NOTOC__{{Trail|Crafting}} {{/Progression}} '''Provisioning''' is a [[Online:Crafting|crafting]] profession in ''[[Online:Online|Elder Scrolls Online]]'' used to transform [[Online:Provisioning Ingredients|provisioning ingredients]] into cooked food and brewed drinks. It is the equivalent of cooking in [[Skyrim:Skyrim|Skyrim]]. Provisioning [[Online:Recipes|recipe]]s are broken into two categories, [[Online:Food Recipes|Food Recipes]] and [[Online:Beverage Recipes|Beverage Recipes]]. You must be at a Cooking Fire in order to create any items. Once you are [[ON:Crafting_Certification|Certified]] in this craft, you will have access to repeatable [[ON:Crafting_Writs|Crafting Writ quests]]. In general, provisioning ingredients can be found by searching sacks, barrels, baskets and crates. [[ON:Grocers|Grocers]] also sell ingredients, but have a limited selection. Various creatures throughout the world can also be hunted for meat. In the other professions, you are able to make items as soon as you have the materials. However, in Provisioning you must have found and learned a recipe before you are able to create any Food or Drink. Recipes may be found as random drops, especially in containers such as Cupboards and Chests and they may be bought from Chefs and Brewers, Guild Stores, or from other players. Completing [[Online:Provisioner Writ|Provisioning Writs]] will give the player a random level specific recipe. In addition to their normal stock of recipes, Chefs and Brewers will have the appropriate recipe for the daily Provisioning Writ. Food items boost at least one of the three stats, Health, Magicka, or Stamina for a period of time. Drinks provide more rapid regeneration of at least one of the three stats over a period of time. Recipes come in four strengths. {{ESO Quality Color|f|Standard Recipes}} are the weakest, and affect only one stat. {{ESO Quality Color|s|Difficult Recipes}} are intermediate, and affect two stats. {{ESO Quality Color|e|Complex Recipes}} are more powerful, and will affect all three stats. {{ESO Quality Color|l|Legendary Recipes}} require the rarest ingredients and usually provide unique bonuses not found elsewhere. In addition to food and drinks, the Provisioning skill allows you to craft [[ON:Furnishing Designs|furnishings]] for your home. [[Online:Fishing|Fish]] can also be fileted at a Cooking Fire. == Learning == The Provisioning skill line is granted the first time you activate a cooking fire. You can increase your skill by crafting food or drinks, learning recipes, and by completing [[ON:Provisioner Writ|Provisioner Writ]]s or [[ON:A Masterful Feast|Master Writs]]. In addition, you can earn free levels in the skill line by reading [[ON:Skill Books|Skill Books]], which may be found randomly on bookshelves anywhere. The skill books which increase Provisioning are: *[[ON:Cooking Mastery, The Easy Way|Cooking Mastery, The Easy Way]] *[[ON:Seafood Supper|Seafood Supper]] *[[ON:Redoran Cooking Secrets|Redoran Cooking Secrets]] *[[ON:A New Recipe?|A New Recipe?]] *[[ON:Baandari Mutton Stew|Baandari Mutton Stew]] == Provisioner Dialogue == You can learn about this profession by asking some of the chefs, brewers or grocers. :'''Can you tell me about provisioning?''' :''"Of course! We provisioners practice the arts of cooking and brewing.
Good food requires the best ingredients. We gather fresh meat and produce from crates, barrels, and the like. If we're lucky, we'll also find recipes in chests, trunks, and desks."'' :'''So you get ingredients and recipes—what then?''' :''"Once you've copied the recipe down and acquired the necessary ingredients, that's when the real fun begins. Cooking pots and rotisseries can be found all over. You need only find one, select a recipe, and then indulge in the simple joy of cooking!"'' :'''What sort of food can I make?''' :''"Don't forget drink!
Hearty meals will fill your belly, increasing your general well-being—both body and soul. Strong drink can stimulate the humors, allowing you to recover more quickly.
If you're lucky, you might find a recipe that does both!"'' ==Stats Affected by Recipes== '''{{ESO Quality Color|f|Standard Recipes:}}''' * Health: {{ESO Quality Color|f|Meat Dishes}} and {{ESO Quality Color|f|Alcoholic Drinks}} * Magicka: {{ESO Quality Color|f|Fruit Dishes}} and {{ESO Quality Color|f|Teas}} * Stamina: {{ESO Quality Color|f|Vegetable Dishes}} and {{ESO Quality Color|f|Tonics}} '''{{ESO Quality Color|s|Difficult Recipes:}}''' * Health and Magicka: {{ESO Quality Color|s|Savouries}} and {{ESO Quality Color|s|Liqueurs}} * Health and Stamina: {{ESO Quality Color|s|Ragout}} and {{ESO Quality Color|s|Tinctures}} * Magicka and Stamina: {{ESO Quality Color|s|Entremet}} and {{ESO Quality Color|s|Cordial Teas}} '''{{ESO Quality Color|e|Complex Recipes:}}''' * Health, Magicka and Stamina: {{ESO Quality Color|e|Gourmet}} and {{ESO Quality Color|e|Distillates}} '''{{ESO Quality Color|l|Legendary Recipes:}}''' * Unique combinations of bonuses: They are found under {{ESO Quality Color|l|Delicacies}}, but not all are marked as gold. ==Skill Perks== Provisioning has an associated skill line that is revealed through use of the Provisioning profession. Online:Woodworking:
{{Trail|Crafting}}{{about|the profession|the skill|Online:Woodworking (skill)}} {{/Progression}} '''Woodworking''' is a [[Online:Crafting|crafting]] profession in ''[[Online:Online|Elder Scrolls Online]]''. It allows you to create staves, shields and bows using wood materials at the woodworking stations. The list of ingredients (logs, sanded wood and resins) used in Woodworking can be found [[Online:Woodworking Materials|here]]. Once you are [[ON:Crafting_Certification|Certified]] in this craft, you will have access to repeatable [[ON:Crafting_Writs|Crafting Writ quests]]. In addition to staves, shields and bows, the Woodworking skill allows you to craft [[ON:Furnishing Blueprints|furnishings]] for your home. == Learning == The Woodworking skill line is granted the first time you activate a woodworking station. You can increase your skill by crafting or deconstructing staves, shields and bows, researching traits, and by completing [[ON:Woodworker Writ|Woodworker Writ]]s or [[ON:A Masterful Shield|Master]] [[ON:A Masterful Weapon (Woodworking)|Writs]]. In addition, you can earn free levels in the skill line by reading [[ON:Skill Books|Skill Books]], which may be found randomly on bookshelves anywhere. The skill books which increase Woodworking are: *[[ON:Bowyer and Fletcher|Bowyer and Fletcher]] *[[ON:One Staff, Many Staves|One Staff, Many Staves]] *[[ON:Strakes and Futtocks|Strakes and Futtocks]] *[[ON:The Year 2920, Vol. 7|The Year 2920, Vol. 7]] *[[ON:Arboreal Architecture|Arboreal Architecture]] *[[ON:Sealed Orders (opened)|Sealed Orders (opened)]] == Carpenter Dialogue == You can learn about this profession by asking some of the carpenters. :'''Can you tell me about woodworking?''' :''"Certainly! Woodworkers shape wood into all manner of useful tools, but [[Online:Bows|bows]], [[Online:Staves|staves]], and [[Online:Shields|shields]] are our specialty. This work requires fine lumber and a sturdy work table.
We also seek out [[Online:Crafting Motifs|style books]] and rare ingredients for more advanced work."'' :'''Can you tell me about the process?''' :''"Sure. While shaping the wood, we can choose a special [[Online:Traits|trait]] to focus on. It takes [[Online:Traits#Research|research]] to discover these techniques, but it's well worth the effort. Increasing the weight or tuning the angle can draw out different advantages in the final product."'' :'''Is there more to it?''' :''"Well, the piece can be improved even more through the use of resins—special elements that enhance the value and quality of your work. The improvement process is delicate, so be sure you've got enough tempers and a steady hand. Good luck!"'' {{NewLine}} == Skill Perks == Woodworking has an associated skill line that is revealed through use of the Woodworking profession. {{About|the effect in combat|Scribing script|Frost Damage (script)}}
'''Frost Damage''' is a type of [[ON:Magical Damage|Magical Damage]] not commonly seen outside of the [[ON:Warden|Warden]] class, as none of the other classes have a skill line devoted to it. It can cause the [[Online:Chilled|Chilled]] status effect, which applies the [[ON:Buffs|Minor Maim]] debuff to the target for 4 seconds, reducing their damage dealt by 5%. Chilled also deals an additional single Frost Damage tick, and makes targets more vulnerable to certain subsequent Frost Damage effects (such as [[ON:Wall of Frost|Wall of Frost]]), which can further apply the [[Online:Immobilize|Immobilize]] debilitating effect.

Some enemies do use it but not many—[[ON:Frost Atronach|Frost Atronach]]s being the most notable.

==Defense==
There are several ways of protecting yourself against Physical Damage.
*A [[ON:Glyph of Decrease Physical Harm|Glyph of Decrease Physical Harm]] Taderi, can be applied to jewelry.
*[[ON:Hardy|Hardy]] in the [[ON:Staving Death|Staving Death]] subconstellation of [[ON:Warfare|Warfare]] reduces Physical Damage taken.

'''Buffs''' and '''Debuffs''' are temporary character [[Online:effects|effects]] applied by some [[Online:abilities|abilities]], [[Online:Sets|sets]], [[Online:potions|potions]], and [[ON:Champion|champion perks]]. Buffs are applied to yourself or your allies, and debuffs are applied to enemies.  Two buffs/debuffs with the same name from different sources will ''not'' stack, though a Major and Minor buff of the same type will. Debuffs can be removed by certain skills or items with [[Online:Cleansing|cleansing]] effects.

Online:Anka-Ra:
<noinclude>{{Trail|Factions}}[[File:ON-npc-Anka-Ra Sentinel.jpg|thumb|right|An Anka-Ra Sentinel]]</noinclude>
The [[Online:Anka-Ra|Anka-Ra]] are a warrior band of the [[Online:Ra Gada|Ra Gada]]. They were led by [[Online:Emperor Tarish-Zi|Emperor Tarish-Zi]], and fought their way as far as [[ON:Craglorn|Craglorn]], where [[Online:Tombs of the Na-Totambu|Tarish-Zi's crypt]] is rumored to lie. The Anka-Ra swore an oath of eternal loyalty to Tarish-Zi, which meant that their spirits were bound to his body, and when [[Online:the Warrior (Celestial)|the Warrior]] summoned forth warriors to his aid the Anka-Ra were brought back from the dead.<noinclude>

Online:Oblivion Damage:
{{Trail|Effects}}
'''Oblivion Damage''' is a type of damage that cannot be resisted by any damage reduction effects or by [[ON:Block|Blocking]]. Physical and Spell Resistance also do not mitigate it and it bypasses [[ON:Damage Shield|Damage Shields]] by always damaging the {{ESO Health Link}} pool. [[ON:Combat#Roll Dodging|Dodging]] however works as usual. Fortunately, sources of Oblivion Damage are very rare, being found mostly as set bonuses.  Note that Oblivion Damage cannot do Critical Strikes. So it is more effective against heavily armored enemies.

==Sources==
===Skills===
*[[ON:Malevolent Offering|Malevolent Offering]] and its morphs deal Oblivion Damage to yourself.
*The [[ON:Anchorite's Cruelty|Anchorite's Cruelty]] Signature Script makes your [[ON:Scribing|scribed]] [[ON:Soul Burst|Soul Burst]] or [[ON:Wield Soul|Wield Soul]] skills consume a [[ON:Soul Gem|Soul Gem]] to deal Oblivion damage over time that scale with the target's {{ESO Health Link|Max}} and deal up to 100% more damage to enemies under 50% Health.

===Enchantments===
*A weapon with a [[ON:Glyph of Decrease Health|Glyph of Decrease Health]] enchantment, made with a subtractive potency rune and {{Item Link|id=45834|Okoma}}, will deal Oblivion Damage.

*More enemies, traps and mechanics than you would think actually deal Oblivion Damage in their attacks. *Players actually have Oblivion Resistance equal to the higher between Physical and Spell Resistance, Oblivion Damage just bypasses it.

The [[Online:Ahemmusa Tribe|Ahemmusa Tribe]] is a tribe of [[Online:Ashlanders|Ashlanders]] living in [[Online:Vvardenfell|Vvardenfell]]. Their main camp is southwest of [[Online:Balmora|Balmora]], in the swamplands of the [[Online:Bitter Coast|Bitter Coast]] region. Like the other major Ashlander tribes, they have sent some members to [[Online:Ald'ruhn|Ald'ruhn]].<noinclude>
 
They are one of the tribes studied and documented by [[ON:Ulran Releth|Ulran Releth]]. Ulran described them as ''"among the most peaceful of the Ashlander tribes and the weakest in terms of amassing any sort of warband"''. He also describes them as hunters and fishermen who prefer to keep to themselves, decorate their clothing with small shells and netting, and use everyday tools (like hunting knives and fishing spears) as weapons when needed to defend themselves.

For more information, see the [[Lore:Ahemmusa Tribe|lore page]].

It works in a similar fashion to the [[ON:Blacksmithing|Blacksmithing]], [[ON:Clothing|Clothing]], and [[ON:Woodworking|Woodworking]] lines, with researchable traits and associated trait items, harvestable leveled materials, and crafting sites added in all regular crafting areas. {{icon|book|New Life Charity Writ|al=right}}
'''New Life Charity Writs''' are special [[ON:New Life Festival|New Life Festival]] themed [[Online:Master Writ|crafting writs]] that require players to create a simple type of furnishing. In 2020, the New Life Charity Writs were removed from the loot table for the {{Item Link|New Life Festival Box|id=96390|quality=2}} though any writs that remained in within the player inventory could be used.

==Obtaining Writs==
:''"A direct request for a dozen simple furnishings, from the Orsinium Home for Displaced Children. Once accepted, this contract cannot be traded or sold. Completing 12 New Life Charity Writs will award you the Crystalfrost Skin."''
Every time a [[Online:New_Life_Festival#Availability|New Life Daily quest]] is completed, Breda will reward you with a [[ON:New Life Gift Box|New Life Gift Box]] which has a chance to contain a Charity Writ. Charity Writs can also be traded or moved between characters. Opting to use one of these writs gives you the opportunity to start the repeatable quest, [[ON:A Charitable Contribution|A Charitable Contribution]]. 

==Crafting==
Unlike completing Master Writs, level 50 in crafting skill is not required to complete a Charity Writ. All the furnishing requested are relatively simple and cheap to make. Some furnishings can only be crafted if you have reached a certain level in the respective crafting skill line and unlocked certain passive skills. The maximum needed requirements to craft all possible items are:

* Metalworking: 2 (Unlocked at Blacksmithing Level 5)
* Tailoring: 4 (unlocked at Clothing Level 15)
* Woodworking: 3 (Unlocked at Woodworking Level 10)

Blueprints, patterns and schematics for those furnishings can be bought for from [[Online:Vendors#Crafting Vendors|Carpenters, Blacksmiths and Clothiers]].

===Possible Furnishings===

* {{Item Link|Common Platter, Serving|id=118034|quality=2}} (x1) 
* {{Item Link|Common Table, Slanted|id=118048|quality=2}} (x1)

* {{Item Link|Rough Bedroll, Basic|id=117963|quality=1}} (x12)
* {{Item Link|Rough Bowl, Common|id=117943|quality=1}} (x12)
* {{Item Link|Rough Cup, Empty|id=120410|quality=1}} (x12)
* {{Item Link|Stool, Carved|id=117991|quality=2}} (x1)

==Reward==
Each writ will reward you with {{ESO WV|1}}, making this an opportunity for players who cannot complete Master Writs to obtain Writ Vouchers. Completing 12 writs will unlock the [[ON:Newly Charitable|Newly Charitable]] achievement, which will unlock the [[ON:Crystalfrost|Crystalfrost]] [[Online:Skins|Skin]]. After the removal of the New Life Charity Writs from the New Life Festival Box loot table, [[ON:Deep Winter Charity Writs|Deep Winter Charity]] and [[ON:Imperial Charity Writs|Imperial Charity Writs]] count towards the achievement instead.

'''Witches Festival Writs''' are special [[Online:Crafting#Crafting_Writs|crafting writs]] that require players to create [[ON:Witches Festival|Witches Festival]] themed food or drink. 

==Related Quests==
*{{Quest Link|Witches Festival Writ}}

==Obtaining Writs==
:''"A direct request for a festive food, from Alyxe the Hag. Once accepted, this contract cannot be traded or sold. Completing 13 Witches Festival Writs awards you the Witch's Infernal Hat; completing 28 grants you the title of "Witch."''
{{Item Link|quality=s|Witches Festival Writs|id=153482}} can be found in [[ON:Dremora Plunder Skull|Dremora Plunder Skulls]] during the Witches Festival. Writs can also be traded or moved between characters. Opting to use one of these writs gives you the opportunity to start the repeatable quest, [[ON:Witches Festival Writ|Witches Festival Writ]], which requests a random food or drink.

In 2019, writs were also available to buy from [[ON:The Impresario|The Impresario]] for 1 [[ON:Event Tickets|Event Ticket]] each in the form of {{Item Link|quality=s|Witches Festival Writ, Wrapped|id=153538}}. However, while the old recipes are relatively common and easily obtainable, you ran the risk of obtaining a writ requesting one of the new rare gold recipes which you '''may not have yet learned'''. Because bought writs are bound to your account and cannot be traded or sold, you will be stuck with this writ until you learn the appropriate recipe, or destroy it.

==Crafting==
Once you accept the quest, you will be asked to create a certain number of Witches Festival food or drink items from the list below. The old recipes for these provisioning items can be found in [[ON:Plunder Skull|Plunder Skull]], whereas the new recipes can only be found in Dremora Plunder Skulls. All writs request '''4''' servings of either food or drink.

The [[ON:Abyssal Cabal|Abyssal Cabal]] is a group of four [[ON:Sea Sload|Sea Sload]] who have banded together for a common goal: to destroy [[ON:Summerset|Summerset]]. They have an arrangement with the [[ON:Court of Bedlam|Court of Bedlam]].<noinclude>

In addition, each member has their own project: Z'Maja has taken [[ON:Cloudrest|Cloudrest]], covering the city in a blanket of shadow and enslaving the shadows of all its  inhabitants, B'Korgen is alchemically empowering the Abyssal Cabal's servants, the [[ON:Yaghra|Yaghra]], in [[ON:Welenkin Cove|Welenkin Cove]], K'Garza is raising an undead army in [[ON:Karnwasten|Karnwasten]], and K'Tora is playing a part in a [[ON:The Triad|greater plot]].

The [[Online:Blackfeather Court|Blackfeather Court]] is a feudal court of talking [[Online:Crow|crows]] that rules over the realm of [[Online:Crow's Wood|Crow's Wood]]. The Court appears once more in the [[ON:Clockwork City|Clockwork City]], having stolen a [[Lore:Skeleton Key|Daedric artifact]] from [[Online:Sotha Sil|Sotha Sil]]. Upon arriving in the Clockwork City and discovering the large bounty of shinies and trinkets to plunder, they revoked their allegiance to [[ON:Nocturnal|Nocturnal]] in favor of claiming this place, putting them at odds with a fellow group of crows still loyal to the Night Mistress, known as the [[ON:Exarchs of Dross|Exarchs of Dross]]. {{FMI}}

The Court offers daily quests which reward {{Item Link|Crow-Touched Clockwork Coffers|id=133559|quality=3|level=1}}, which may contain chapters for learning to craft the [[ON:Ebonshadow Style|Ebonshadow style]].

The [[Online:Ash'abah|Ash'abah]] are a group of [[Online:Redguard|Redguards]] who are pariahs from the rest of society due to their delegated role: fighting the undead.<noinclude>

In Redguard culture, desecrating honored ancestors is considered the worst action imaginable and brings [[Lore:Tu'whacca|Tu'whacca]]'s curse upon the family of anyone who takes up arms against risen dead. For this reason, [[Lore:Necromancy|necromancers]] have historically targeted the [[Online:Alik'r Desert|Alik'r Desert]]. The Ash'abah were created to fight back, at a cost: they are hated by other Redguards, and exiled to [[Online:Morwha's Bounty|Morwha's Bounty]] south of [[Online:Sentinel|Sentinel]]. When the dead rise, the Ash'abah are called upon to help, but otherwise they are shunned. For more historical information on the Ash'abah, see the [[Lore:Ash'abah|lore article]].

As part of the [[Online:Daggerfall Covenant|Daggerfall Covenant]] questline, you become Ash'abah and walk in the footsteps of the first: a prince of Alik'r.

Online:Bleak Veil:
<noinclude>{{Mod Header|Thieves Guild}}{{Trail|Factions}}</noinclude>
<noinclude>[[File:ON-npc-Bleak Veil.jpg|thumb|right|Some Bleak Veil Necromancers]]</noinclude>
The [[Online:Bleak Veil|Bleak Veil]] were originally a displaced group of [[Lore:Necromancy|necromancers]] from inner [[ON:Hammerfell|Hammerfell]], led by [[ON:Magnifico Bahraha|Magnifico Bahraha]], that relocated to [[ON:Hew's Bane|Hew's Bane]]. The group began to build a specifically designed royal tomb that could be used as a conduit of necrotic energy for rituals.<noinclude> However, once [[Lore:Hubalajad|Prince Hubalajad]] learned of his uncle's plans, he had them sealed into the tomb—which was soon known locally as [[ON:Bahraha's Gloom|Bahraha's Gloom]] and the incident became the secret shame of the royal family.

Unbeknownst to the outside world, the cult continued to survive, with its cultists drawing lots to see who would be sacrificed for the ascension of the few. The seal which keeps them imprisoned needs to be recharged periodically and once had an entire order devoted to it. By [[Lore:Second Era#Sixth Century|2E 582]], the order has dwindled to a single [[Online:Sabileh|member]]. This seal was recently broken by a group of treasure hunters known as the [[ON:Salt Catchers|Salt Catchers]], who then became the new cult's newest playthings.

Online:Ashlanders:
<noinclude>{{Trail|Factions}}{{about|the Dunmeri faction|the passive ability|Ashlander|NPCs with this name|ON:Ashlander (NPC)}}[[File:ON-place-Erabenimsun Camp.jpg|thumb|right|An Ashlander camp]]</noinclude>
[[Online:Ashlanders|Ashlanders]] are a faction of nomadic [[Online:Dark Elf|Dunmer]]. It comprises numerous different tribes, mainly found in [[ON:Stonefalls|Stonefalls]], [[Online:Deshaan|Deshaan]] and on the island of [[ON:Vvardenfell|Vvardenfell]]. On Vvardenfell, there are four main tribes; the [[ON:Ahemmusa Tribe|Ahemmusa]], [[ON:Erabenimsun Tribe|Erabenimsun]], [[ON:Urshilaku Tribe|Urshilaku]], and [[ON:Zainab Tribe|Zainab]], plus some bandit groups consisting of outcasts from the main tribes. On the mainland, there are two major tribes; the [[ON:Kagesh|Kagesh]] and [[ON:Mabrigash|Mabrigash]], and two smaller hostile tribes; the [[ON:Ulath Tribe|Ulath]] and [[ON:Vereansu|Vereansu]]. For more information, see the [[Lore:Ashlanders|lore page]].<noinclude>

This faction has two unique equipment styles, [[Online:Ashlander Style|one of which]] can be learned by the player. The chapters for this style are occasionally given as rewards for completing the Ashlander daily quests given by [[ON:Huntmaster Sorim-Nakar|Huntmaster Sorim-Nakar]] and [[ON:Numani-Rasi|Numani-Rasi]]. Crafting Ashlander items requires {{icon|style material|Ash Canvas|18}}'''[[ON:Ash Canvas|{{ESO Quality Color|n|Ash Canvas}}]]'''. [[ON:Shadow of the Red Mountain|Shadow of the Red Mountain]] is a medium armor set in the other Ashlander style that can be found in [[ON:Stonefalls|Stonefalls]].

==Notes==
* [[ON:Captain Kaleen|Captain Kaleen]] pokes fun at the recurring motif of a secretive evil cult in every chapter when you ask her about the Abyssal Cabal, saying she can't be bothered to tell the difference and an "Average Assembly" should be thrown in for good measure.
* Some files refer to the group as the "Scribes of Truth", suggesting this was their original working name.
*According to Slavicsek, the Ascendant Order has "what they consider to be a noble purpose... it's just a matter of how you interpret what they're doing." Leamon Tuttle went on to describe the Ascendant Order as "a pan-Tamrielic movement", not a group restricted just to [[ON:High Isle|High Isle]].<ref>https://gamerant.com/elder-scrolls-online-high-isle-loremaster-lead-writer-interview/</ref> Slavicsek comments, "They don't reveal their identities, they wear their helmets all the time, and in some ways, they act like terrorists as they try to go about achieving their goals. They have what they consider to be a noble purpose... it's just a matter of how you interpret what they're doing and the fallout it causes." "That's actually a good thing, right? We want to end the war," Slavicsek says. "It's a matter of how they go about doing it that becomes the driving force of the story. And their leaders — we've got a few of them that you'll meet across the length of the story — are these individuals that at least on the surface have noble goals and believe in things that most of the common folk of Tamriel would probably support until people start dying."<ref>https://ftw.usatoday.com/2022/01/elder-scrolls-online-lore-interview</ref>

Online:Blackroot Clan:
<noinclude>{{Trail|Factions}}</noinclude>
The [[Online:Blackroot Clan|Blackroot Clan]] is a clan of [[ON:Bosmer|Bosmer]] warriors located in [[ON:Greenshade|Greenshade]]. In life, led by [[ON:General Malgoth|General Malgoth]], they conducted a vicious campaign of conquest against surrounding clans and villages, following the Meat Mandate after every battle by consuming the flesh of their enemies.<noinclude>

While seemingly unbeatable, they finally met their end during their raid on [[ON:Dread Vullain|Vullain]]. After eating the fallen, the soldiers realized the villagers had poisoned themselves to defeat the Blackroot Clan in death, and they all perished soon after.

After many years had gone by, the [[ON:Veiled Heritance|Veiled Heritance]] arrived in the area, where they raised the Blackroot Clan soldiers as [[ON:Undead|undead]] warriors to put at their command.

Online:Blessed Inheritors:
<noinclude>{{Trail|Factions}}{{Mod Header|Scribes of Fate}}__NOTOC__</noinclude>
The [[ON:Blessed Inheritors|Blessed Inheritors]] are a group of isolationist [[ON:House Telvanni|Telvanni]] who were led to [[ON:Bal Sunnar|Bal Sunnar]] by [[ON:Matriarch Lladi Telvanni|Matriarch Lladi Telvanni]] in the [[Lore:First Era|First Era]], and have remained there into the [[Lore:Fourth Era|Fourth Era]]. They were initially composed of [[ON:Chimer|Chimer]] cursed into [[Online:Dark Elf|Dunmer]] who did not approve of the Tribunal being self-appointed as god-rulers of [[ON:Morrowind (province)|Resdayn]], and travelled to a sheltered valley in the [[ON:Stonefalls|Stonefalls]] for safety and seclusion.<noinclude> It was here that the Matriarch commanded them to dig for their blessed "inheritance" found deep underground, which was in truth a [[Lore:Glyphic|glyphic]]. They performed many experiments and other cruelties on their [[ON:Argonian|Argonian]] slaves who built their homes, and keep them in cages. Should you free the slaves, they will build you a puzzle that you can solve in the future to grant your group a boon.

With their defeat at your hands in the past, they have remembered your group as the Scourge that cut down their families. In the present, the Blessed Inheritors have used the secrets of their inherited glyphic to gain power over [[Lore:Time Magic|Time Magic]] and created a temporal knot in the Tower of Shadow's Blessing. In an attempt to control your fate, they will send you to the past, back to the time of the town's construction, where the Matriarch will flee due to your intrusion and travel to the future. The temporal knot in the past will later fling you into the far future, where a [[Lore:Red Year|rain of fire]] has burned down the town. You will discover that the Matriarch has returned and converted the peaceful descendants of the Inheritors into a [[ON:Peryite|Peryite]] cult by promising them salvation from the eruption, building a temple and using them for sacrifices that have brought monstrous beasts. Once you defeat the Matriarch in the future, you can recover the glyphic and return to the present, finally ending the threat once and for all.

Online:Council of Province Generals:
<noinclude>{{Trail|Factions}}[[File:ON-quest-Proving the Deed 03.jpg|thumb|right|Council of Province Generals]]</noinclude>
The [[Online:Council of Province Generals|Council of Province Generals]] is a council of the [[Online:Fighters Guild|Fighters Guild]]'s highest ranks. Each general represents a former province of the [[Lore:Second Empire|Empire]], managing the guild's business there on behalf of the guildmaster.<noinclude> 

Following the death of Guildmaster [[Online:Jofnir Iceblade|Jofnir Iceblade]] and due to the unrest of the [[Lore:Interregnum|Interregnum]] period, the number of delegates have lessened. Only five former provinces are represented in the Council: [[Online:Cyrodiil|Cyrodiil]], [[ON:Elsweyr (province)|Elsweyr]], [[Online:High Rock|High Rock]], [[Online:Skyrim|Skyrim]], and [[Online:Valenwood|Valenwood]]. 

You will first encounter the Council in [[ON:Fort Amol|Fort Amol]], [[ON:Sentinel|Sentinel]], or [[ON:Vulkwasten|Vulkwasten]] during the quest [[Online:Proving the Deed|Proving the Deed]], and once more at the [[Online:The Earth Forge|Earth Forge]] during [[Online:Will of the Council|Will of the Council]].

== Council Members ==
* [[Online:Borogilmith|Borogilmith]] is the Province General of Valenwood
* [[Online:Countess Hakruba|Countess Hakruba]] is the Province General of High Rock and the leader of the Council
* [[Online:General Flaminius Auctor|General Flaminius Auctor]] is the Province General of Cyrodiil
* [[Online:Ra'zaym Iron-Ear|Ra'zaym Iron-Ear]] is the Province General of Elsweyr 
* [[Online:Svalkmar the Crude|Svalkmar the Crude]] is the Province General of Skyrim

Online:Coldharbour Elite Guard:
<noinclude>{{Trail|Factions}}{{Mod Header|Imperial City}}[[File:ON-npc-Tarkatix of the Crimson Blade.jpg|thumb|right|A Xivkyn general with a blue banner]]{{about|the public dungeon enemy bosses|the group dungeon bosses|Online:Elite Guard}}{{TOCright|limit=2}}</noinclude>
The [[Online:Coldharbour Elite Guard|Coldharbour Elite Guard]], also called the '''Xivkyn Elite''' or "'''Banners'''", are an extremely powerful group of [[ON:Xivkyn|Xivkyn]] located in the [[ON:Imperial Sewers|Imperial City Sewers]] who serve as [[ON:Molag Bal|Molag Bal]]'s generals.<noinclude> They are [[Online:Sweepers|sweeper]] bosses; they patrol various parts of the sewers in a looping path and will become hostile should they detect you or a group member, which makes them difficult to escape as they are not [[Online:Leashing|leashed]]. They are some of the most powerful enemies in the game and most often require a large group to defeat a single one.

The Elite can be distinguished by the large banners found on their backs, large amounts of health, and the glowing ring surrounding them that prevents stealth. The power of each general can usually be determined by the color of their banner, with red banners possessing more magicka-based ranged and AoE attacks, making them more powerful than their stamina-based blue banner counterparts, who use mostly melee attacks. Similar to the overland [[ON:Patrolling Horrors|Patrolling Horrors]], when a guard is killed, they will later be replaced by another member of the Xivkyn Elite who will patrol the same path. There are, by default, nine wandering generals in the sewers, with three in each alliance territory.

In the [[ON:Barathrum Centrata|Barathrum Centrata]], when every wave of generic enemies is defeated at one of the three inner portals, a general will spawn and must be killed to close it. Once three generals are defeated, the [[ON:Simulacrum of Molag Bal|Simulacrum of Molag Bal]] will spawn. Since each portal is on a timer, it is possible that when the timer ends, the general will run back to the portal and disappear during combat, and the portal will be reset.

==Skills and Abilities==
[[File:ON-npc-Thrasotin the Ravenous Flame.jpg|thumb|right|A Xivkyn general with a red banner]]
Xivkyn from the listed skill groups can have a combination of abilities in their classification. For example, Thrasotin the Ravenous Flame can use Drain Essence, but can't set down Vampiric Totems. The following abilities are shared between all class ability pools:

;Mind Spike:The boss reveals all stealthed players in an area around it at all times, as seen by a blue ring when crouching. Any revealed player cannot return to stealth for some time. This passive is used by all patrolling Coldharbour Elite Guards.
;Soul Devour: When a player dies while in combat with a member of the Coldharbour Elite Guard, it absorbs the player's energy and heals itself for 15% of its {{ESO Health Link|Max}}. This passive is used by all patrolling Coldharbour Elite Guards.
;Healing Shield: The boss envelops itself in a yellow barrier and gets a damage shield of 4% of its {{ESO Health Link|Max}}. The boss cannot be interrupted until the shield is destroyed, or it disappears by itself after some time.
;Daedric Heal: The Xivkyn heals itself over time for 1% of its {{ESO Health Link|Max}} per tick, with the first tick healing 18% less. This ability can be interrupted to stagger the boss.
;Summon Vampiric Totem: The Xivkyn summons three [[Online:Vampiric Totem|Vampiric Totems]]. These totems draw life from players standing near them by dealing continuous low magic damage, and when they disappear, they send their collected life energy to the boss, healing it for 10% of its {{ESO Health Link|Max}} for each totem left standing. If a Vampiric Totem is destroyed, it sends its life energy to nearby players instead and heals them each for {{huh|33%? 50%?}}{{vn|plain}} of their {{ESO Health Link|Max}} (Vampiric Debt)
;Vampiric Ground: The Xivkyn summons a black circle of shadowy mist under itself and under every nearby player, for up to four areas. They sap the health of anyone who stands in it. The circles deal continuous direct high magic damage and snare those who stand in them. They deal less damage for the first two hits, and more damage starting with the third. They also begin to heal the Xivkyn after the third hit for 1% of their {{ESO Health Link|Max}} per hit.
;Drain Essence: The Xivkyn grabs a target with a beam of blood magic, stunning them and draining their health to heal themselves. Every tick deals very high direct magic damage and heals the Xivkyn for 2% of their {{ESO Health Link|Max}}, except the first tick which heals half that amount. This ability also heals for 5% of the Xivkyn's {{ESO Health Link|Max}} if the target dies while being drained.

[[File:ON-npc-Obb, Carver of Souls.jpg|Obb, a two-hander|right|thumb]]
===Blue Banner===
The following abilities are shared among blue banners:
;Quick Strike: A basic, single-target melee attack dealing high [[ON:Physical Damage|physical damage]].
;Daedric Whip: A [[ON:Lava Whip|Lava Whip]]-like ability dealing very high [[ON:Flame Damage|flame damage]] and knocking back. This can be blocked to stagger the boss instead.
;Rotating Reflective Shield: The boss casts a reflective shield. While it is green, the shield reduces its damage taken from melee attacks and reflects ranged physical attacks, each attack working as if the Xivkyn casted it itself (such as healing or applying a debuff on hit), except dealing moderate generic damage instead. While the shield is blue, the shield reflects spell projectiles back to their caster but for way less damage. If enough projectiles have been reflected, the shield turns white and the boss enrages for a short time, dealing more damage. A strong metal sound is heard every time the shield reflects a projectile. "Generic Damage" is reduced by your armor and damage taken reduction effects.

====Two-Handed====
;Steel Cyclone: A melee AoE attack where the boss swings their weapon around in circles while moving towards a target, dealing continuous direct massive physical damage to those within range of the weapon.
;Uppercut: An [[ON:Uppercut|Uppercut]]-like attack dealing very high physical damage and knocking the target back. This can be blocked to stagger the boss instead.

====One-Hand and Shield====
;Fiery Breath: The boss breathes fire not unlike the [[ON:Fiery Breath|Fiery Breath]] ability, dealing devastating flame damage in a frontal cone.
;Dark Talons: The boss uses a [[ON:Dark Talons|Dark Talons]]-like ability which roots nearby targets in place for 4 seconds and deals high physical damage.
{{NewLeft}}

[[File:ON-npc-Nomo-Rerak, Arbiter of Pain.jpg|Nomo-Rerak, a dual wielder|right|thumb]]
====Dual Wield====
;Veiled Strike: The boss turns invisible and winds up, preparing to perform a close-range attack dealing major [[ON:Magic Damage|magic damage]] and stunning the target. This can be blocked to stagger the boss instead.
;Teleport Strike: The Boss teleports to the target, dealing high magic damage and stunning the target. This ability can be blocked to negate the stun.
;Daedric Fury: The Xivkyn enrages, which knocks back nearby targets. They then glow red and have flames on their daggers for a time. This increases their damage done, snares them and makes them only use Enraged Strike.
;Enraged Strike: A basic melee attack dealing major physical damage. It looks like a fast dual wield heavy attack.

===Red Banner===
As red banners use elemental staves instead of weapons dealing physical damage, they have no shared constants that don't also extend to blue banners.

[[File:ON-npc-Skalhexx the Cremator.jpg|Skalhexx, a fire mage|right|thumb]]
====Fire Mage====
;Flare: A basic ranged attack that hits up to up to four targets, dealing high [[ON:Flame Damage|flame damage]] to each.
;Daedric Eruption/Daedric Inferno: The boss raises their staff and causes a large [[Online:AoE|AoE]] to bloom, one placed under the boss and one under each player (up to four areas). When they peak, they erupt, dealing two ticks of direct high flame damage to targets caught in the blast (Daedric Eruption). Then the areas are re-cast the same way, under players that were not hit by the first blast, dealing two ticks of direct high flame damage to targets caught in the blast (Daedric Inferno). Getting hit by either applies "Daedric Flame", or refreshes it if you're already suffering from it.
;Daedric Flame: Deals very minor flame damage over 10 seconds.
;Fire Runes: The boss sets up to four AoEs on the ground dealing continuous direct major flame damage when you stand in them. One area is always placed under a player.
;Heat Wave: The boss winds up a fire spell, then releases three lines of flame that travel forward, dealing high flame damage to targets hit.
{{NewLeft}}

[[File:ON-npc-Skoorn, the Blizzard's Edge.jpg|Skoorn, a frost mage|right|thumb]]
====Frost Mage====
;Ice Arrow: A basic ranged attack fired at one or two targets, dealing high [[ON:Frost Damage|frost damage]].
;Daedric Chill: The boss summons temporary [[Online:AoE|AoEs]] dealing continuous direct high frost damage and heavily snare all players standing in them. One area spawns under the boss and one under every nearby player, for up to four areas. If you stand in two overlapping areas, you'll take damage from both.
;Winter's Reach: The boss sends three frozen gales whirling forward, each dealing very high frost damage and rooting targets hit. The root bypasses block and the frozen gales do not have indicators.

====Necromancer====
;Entropic Bolt: A basic ranged attack where the boss fires a blue skull at the target, dealing moderate-high [[ON:Magic Damage|magic damage]].
;Daedric Chains: The boss pulls you towards them with a blue chain made of magic, dealing moderate [[ON:Physical Damage|physical damage]]. When you reach the boss, you will be stunned, and need to break free before the boss uses '''Force Pulse'''.
;Force Pulse: The boss channels an AoE of blue necromantic energy. When it peaks, it explodes, dealing very high magic damage.
;Necrotic Swarm: The boss holds their staff up. Blue necromantic energy flows forth from the end of the staff which continuously launches tracking bolts at targets, each dealing direct moderate [[ON:Frost Damage|frost damage]]. '''Daedric Resonance''' and '''Daedric Shards''' occur at this time.
;Bone Cage:The Xivkyn casts a rune on the ground that activates after a while, [[Online:Combat#Root|rooting]] targets who step in it. This can be [[Online:Interrupt|interrupted]] to stagger the Xivkyn. This cannot be blocked.
;Daedric Resonance: Areas dealing continuous moderate-high frost damage appear with a Lich Crystal at the center and disappear when the Lich Crystal explodes.
;Daedric Shards: Lich Crystals rise from the '''Daedric Resonance''' areas, exploding after one second. If you're caught in the [[ON:AoE|AoE]], you'll be hit by a blast of high frost damage and stunned.
;Summon Atronach: The boss summons a [[Online:Flesh Atronach|flesh atronach]]. The flesh Atronach dies when the boss is defeated.

Online:Clockwork Apostles:
<noinclude>{{Trail|Factions}}{{Mod Header|Clockwork City}}
[[File:ON-render-Proctor Luciana.jpg|thumb|Proctor Luciana Pullo, a prominent Clockwork Apostle]]</noinclude>
The [[Online:Clockwork Apostles|Clockwork Apostles]] are followers of [[Online:Sotha Sil|Sotha Sil]] who, during his absence, govern the [[ON:Clockwork City|Clockwork City]] from the [[ON:Clockwork Basilica|Clockwork Basilica]] within the walls of the [[ON:Brass Fortress|Brass Fortress]].<noinclude> 

Apostle culture shares parallels with the very machines they live around. Society is regimented with every Apostle having a distinct purpose; as a cog in a machine does - for example one may study Sotha Sil's scholarly works as another maintains the myriad of functions the Clockwork City performs. Those who cannot find a role in society are cast out and known as the [[ON:Tarnished|Tarnished]].  

While the Apostles provide civic functions such as maintaining [[ON:Justice|law and order]] within the [[ON:Brass Fortress|Brass Fortress]], they also seek to further the academic understanding of Clockwork through research and study. Notably they do not regulate commerce, although negotiations are made with outside [[ON:Guild Traders|guild traders]] for the use of commerce [[ON:Factotum|factotums]].

Clockwork Apostles often elect to have their limbs and bodily functions replaced by artificial components made from brass. The chest is covered by robes and this forms an easy way to visually identify a Clockwork Apostle.   

For historical information, see the [[Lore:Clockwork Apostles|lore article]].

Online:Cult of the Ancestor Moth:
<noinclude>{{Trail|Factions}}[[File:ON-banner-Cult of the Ancestor Moth.png|thumb|Banner of the Cult]]</noinclude>
The [[ON:Cult of the Ancestor Moth|Cult of the Ancestor Moth]] is a priesthood dedicated to reading the [[ON:Elder Scrolls|Elder Scrolls]]. Their higher ranking members, called Moth Priests or Augurs, study the scrolls for knowledge to the point where they lose their eyesight.<noinclude>

The group is headquartered at the [[ON:Temple of the Ancestor Moths|Temple of the Ancestor Moths]] in [[ON:Cyrodiil|Cyrodiil]], where the Elder Scrolls they hid were stolen by the [[ON:Alliances|three Alliances]] and housed in large [[Online:Scroll Temples|Scroll Temples]]. A martial art known as the ''Way of the Peaceful Fist'' is practiced by the remaining residents of Temple. 

In the [[ON:White-Gold Tower|White-Gold Tower]], [[Online:Sister Terran Arminus|Moth Sister Terran Arminus]] has been recruited by [[Online:Empress Regent Clivia Tharn|Empress Regent Clivia Tharn]] to find an Elder Scroll in the Tower's ruined library. Tharn's missing husband, [[ON:Varen Aquilarios|Emperor Varen Aquilarios]], became a member of the priesthood after waking up at the steps of the Abbey of the Moth Priests with no memory of his past life following the [[Lore:Soulburst|Soulburst]].

The gladiators are divided into three teams: the [[ON:Fire Drakes|Fire Drakes]], the [[ON:Pit Daemons|Pit Daemons]], and the [[ON:Storm Lords|Storm Lords]]. Some gladiators prefer to stick to one team, while others will change on a match-by-match basis. For more information, see the [[ON:Battlegrounds|Battlegrounds]] page or the [[Lore:Circle of Champions|lore]] page.

Gladiators (along with Battlegrounds vendors) can be found in [[ON:Gladiator's Quarters|Gladiator's Quarters]] in a handful of cities. They can also be found at the gates of the battlegrounds at [[ON:Ald Carac|Ald Carac]], [[ON:Foyada Quarry|Foyada Quarry]], and [[ON:Ularra|Ularra]].

Online:Bright-Throat Tribe:
{{Mod Header|Murkmire}}
<noinclude>{{Trail|Factions}}</noinclude>
The [[ON:Bright-Throat Tribe|Bright-Throat Tribe]] is an influential [[ON:Argonian|Argonian]] tribe dwelling in [[Online:Murkmire|Murkmire]]. The tribe has a reputation for being the most hospitable tribe in the region, openly trading with nearby [[ON:Lilmoth|Lilmoth]] and the other tribes as well as for the seed-dolls they carve. Its members are generally known for their bright and colorful scales.<noinclude>  

The most notable thing about the tribe is their annual bonding ritual. The Bright-Throats believe that inviting neighboring tribes to their bonding ceremony is a show of respect and kinship, and that bonding together strengthens their relationships with one another as they are all egg-brothers and egg-sisters.

Following completion of [[ON:Empty Nest|Empty Nest]], you are considered root-kin by the tribe.

The [[Online:Coterie of Organized Scholars|Coterie of Organized Scholars]] are an organization devoted to study and research in [[ON:Western Skyrim|Western Skyrim]]. As some assignments are more dangerous than others, the Coterie of Organized Scholars often hire adventurers to help with collecting research materials.

Online:Daggerfall Covenant:
{{Trail|Factions}} [[File:ON-concept-Daggerfall Covenant.jpg|thumb|left|The Daggerfall Covenant]] [[File:ON-icon-Daggerfall Covenant.png|right|100px]] [[File:ON-map-Daggerfall Covenant.jpg|thumb|right|A map of the Daggerfall Covenant's home territory]] The [[Online:Daggerfall Covenant|Daggerfall Covenant]] is one of the three joinable factions participating in the [[Online:Alliance War|Alliance War]], the other two being the [[Online:Aldmeri Dominion|Aldmeri Dominion]] and the [[Online:Ebonheart Pact|Ebonheart Pact]]. The crest of the Daggerfall Covenant is a lion, and its colors are blue and silver. It consists of the kingdoms of [[ON:High Rock|High Rock]], the Kingdom of [[Online:Orsinium|Orsinium]], and the Kingdom of [[Online:Sentinel|Sentinel]]. The alliance is an egalitarian association which uses its military might to secure lucrative trade routes. Led by [[Online:High King Emeric|High King Emeric]] of [[Online:Wayrest|Wayrest]], the Covenant seeks to capture the [[Lore:Ruby Throne|Ruby Throne]] in order to restore the [[Lore:Second Empire|Second Empire]] and return stability to [[ON:Tamriel|Tamriel]]. Covenant players will begin on [[Online:Stros M'Kai|Stros M'Kai]] after being washed up unconscious on the shores of the island following their escape from [[Online:Molag Bal|Molag Bal]]'s realm of [[Online:Coldharbour|Coldharbour]]. The marriage of King Emeric to Princess [[ON:Maraya|Maraya]] of Sentinel led to the Kingdom of Sentinel, under [[Online:King Fahara'jad|King Fahara'jad]], entering a trade agreement with High Rock. The [[Online:Orc|Orcs]] of Orsinium, led by [[Online:King Kurog|King Kurog]], joined the alliance after Emeric pledged to restore their kingdom following their assistance in [[Lore:Ranser's War|Ranser's War]]; however, there are a number of Orcish tribes both in and outside of the [[Lore:Wrothgarian Mountains|Wrothgarian Mountains]] who remain independent of the Covenant. Online:Ebonheart Pact:
{{Trail|Factions}} [[File:ON-concept-Ebonheart Pact.jpg|thumb|left|The Ebonheart Pact]] [[File:ON-icon-Ebonheart Pact.png|right|100px]] [[File:ON-map-Ebonheart Pact.jpg|thumb|right|A map of the Ebonheart Pact's home territory]] The [[Online:Ebonheart Pact|Ebonheart Pact]] is one of the three joinable factions participating in the [[Online:Alliance War|Alliance War]], the other two being the [[Online:Aldmeri Dominion|Aldmeri Dominion]] and the [[Online:Daggerfall Covenant|Daggerfall Covenant]]. The crest of the Ebonheart Pact is a dragon, and its colors are red and black. It consists of four of the five [[Online:Dark Elf|Dunmer]] [[Lore:Great Houses|Great Houses]] of [[ON:Morrowind (province)|Morrowind]], the [[Online:Nord|Nordic]] kingdom of [[Lore:Eastern Skyrim|Eastern Skyrim]] and the [[Online:Argonian|Argonian]] tribes of northern [[ON:Black Marsh|Black Marsh]]. The alliance was reluctantly formed out of necessity; despite the three races' ancestral hatred for each other, they recognized the threat posed by their unified enemies, both at home and from across the sea, and banded together to protect their borders and freedom. Led by [[Online:Jorunn the Skald-King|Jorunn the Skald-King]], who presides over the [[Lore:Moot|Great Moot]] in the Pact's capital of [[Online:Mournhold|Mournhold]], the alliance seeks to defeat the corrupt Empire and preserve the independence of its homelands. Pact players will begin on [[Online:Bleakrock Isle|Bleakrock Isle]] after being washed up unconscious on the shores of the island following their escape from [[Online:Molag Bal|Molag Bal]]'s realm of [[Online:Coldharbour|Coldharbour]]. The Great Houses hold a lot of power in Morrowind. All but [[ON:House Telvanni|House Telvanni]] agreed to join the Pact, and the Telvanni have now become somewhat estranged from the other houses because of it. Black Marsh has no monarchy, but certain Saxhleel tribes joined the Pact to protect their interests. Under the terms of the Alliance, slavery was nominally outlawed; but [[Online:House Dres|House Dres]] was allowed to keep non-Argonian slaves, with [[ON:Khajiit|Khajiit]] being the most common race currently enslaved. All Argonian slaves were released. For historical information, see the [[Lore:Ebonheart Pact|lore article]]. {{NewLeft}} ==Territory== [[File:ON-banner-Ebonheart Pact.png|right]] The Ebonheart Pact's home territory covers Eastern [[Lore:Skyrim|Skyrim]] and parts of the traditional provinces of [[Lore:Morrowind|Morrowind]] and [[Lore:Black Marsh|Black Marsh]]. *{{Place Link|Bal Foyen}} *{{Place Link|Bleakrock Isle}} *{{Place Link|Deshaan}} *{{Place Link|Eastmarch}} *{{Place Link|The Rift}} *{{Place Link|Shadowfen}} *{{Place Link|Stonefalls}} The Pact also have a territorial claim over the eastern and northeastern parts of the [[Lore:Heartlands|Imperial heartlands]]. *{{Place Link|Cyrodiil}} **{{Place Link|Ebonheart Territory}} [[Online:Vvardenfell|'''Vvardenfell''']] is only partially part the alliance through Houses Redoran and Hlaalu, while territory not under their jurisdiction is neutral. As such, it is not marked as Pact territory on the wiki. ==Quests== {{ESO Veteran|almanac= Quests with this marker are required for Cadwell's Almanac.
