Online:Dragonguard:
<noinclude>{{Trail|Factions}}{{About|the faction|the set|Akaviri Dragonguard}}[[File:ON-banner-Dragonguard (small).png|right|100px|]]</noinclude>
The [[Online:Dragonguard|Dragonguard]] are the predecessors of the [[Lore:Blades|Blades]]. Originally from [[Lore:Akavir|Akavir]], the Dragonguard came to [[Online:Tamriel|Tamriel]] to serve the [[Lore:Dragonborn|Dragonborn]], [[Lore:Reman I|Reman I]]. Although officially disbanded at the end of the [[Lore:First Era|First Era]], the Dragonguard continue to wait for the next Dragonborn to claim the [[Lore:Ruby Throne|Ruby Throne]].<noinclude> They are seemingly unrelated to [[ON:Clivia Tharn|Clivia Tharn]]'s [[ON:Elite Guard|Elite Guard]].

[[ON:Dragonguard Orland|Dragonguard Orland]], the seemingly last member of the order in [[ON:Elsweyr (province)|Elsweyr]], has a bounty on his head placed by [[ON:Euraxia Tharn|Euraxia Tharn]] to appease the returned [[ON:Dragon|dragons]]. [[ON:Sai Sahan|Sai Sahan]] returns to reform the Dragonguard in [[Online:Southern Elsweyr|Southern Elsweyr]], featured in the [[ON:Dragonhold|Dragonhold]] DLC.

{{FMI}}
==Joining the Dragonguard==
In the [[Online:Dragonhold|Dragonhold]] DLC, players are able to aid Sai Sahan in the reconstruction of the Dragonguard. Unlike other factions that feature their own skill lines, players enjoy other perks that are acquired by rebuilding the [[Online:Dragonguard Sanctum|Dragonguard Sanctum]]. Rebuilding the sanctum is done by doing quests related to the Dragonguard. Quests from the Main Story of the Dragonhold, as well as dailies obtained from the Sanctum's quest givers, [[Online:Chizbari the Chipper|Chizbari the Chipper]] and [[Online:Dirge Truptor|Dirge Truptor]], count toward the progress. Progress can be tracked in the achievements list, and every milestone unlocks more NPCs to liven up the Sanctuary. The notable unlockable perks at every milestone are:
*[[Online:A Call to Arms|A Call to Arms]] achievement unlocked (milestone of 4 quests): [[Online:Chukka-Jekka|Chef Service]] unlocked.
*[[Online:Restoring the Order|Restoring the Order]] achievement unlocked (milestone of 12 quests): Dragonguard Inner Sanctum unlocked, as well as the crafting station for the [[Online:Ancient Dragonguard|Ancient Dragonguard]] set.
*[[Online:Reforging the Dragonguard|Reforging the Dragonguard]] achievement unlocked (milestone of 20 quests): [[Online:Martina Ocella|Achievement Furnisher NPC]] unlocked. [[Online:The Good Bits (quest)|The Good Bits]] quest becomes available, which grants access to the alchemy reagent [[Online:Dragon Rheum|Dragon Rheum]] upon completion.
*[[Online:Dragonguard Operative|Dragonguard Operative]] achievement unlocked (milestone of 30 quests): unlocks access to the daily rewards chest, the Dragonguard Supply Chest, located in front of Dirge Truptor.

The [[Online:Dead-Water Tribe|Dead-Water Tribe]], or the ''"Naga-Kur"'' in [[Lore:Jel|Jel]], as they more commonly refer to themselves, are a tribe of [[ON:Naga|Nagas]] residing in their [[ON:Dead-Water Village|village]] in northwestern [[ON:Murkmire|Murkmire]].

Unlike the tribeless Nagas that inhabit the region, the Naga-Kur are proud warriors, deeply entrenched in tradition. They are feared by neighboring tribes due to their brutal ways and are considered hostile to outsiders.<noinclude> 

However, [[ON:Olik-Reenus|some]] members of the tribe defend their undiplomatic nature, claiming that outsiders ''"mistake a show of strength for hostility"'' and that what outsiders ''"call inhospitable, we consider prudent."''

The Dead-Water Tribe are led by their aged and irascible war-chief, [[Online:Raj-Kaal Seelan|Raj-Kaal Seelan]], while their novice warriors are trained by their ka-deelith, [[Online:Mewah-Jez|Mewah-Jez]], who prepares them to walk the [[Online:Path of the Lily|Path of the Lily]], a series of warrior trials. 

Following the completion of [[Online:Death Among the Dead-Water|Death Among the Dead-Water]], [[ON:Kishi|Kishi]] will be appointed as a ka-deelith alongside Mewah-Jez, whose ineffective teaching methods he has criticized as leading numerous young warriors to their deaths. 

For historical information, see the [[Lore:Naga-Kur|lore article]].

These quests can be shared with other members of your group, so it is possible to do up to 15 of these quests in a day. Online:Fists of Thalmor:
<noinclude>{{Trail|Factions}}{{About||the note|Fists of Thalmor (note)}}</noinclude>
The [[Online:Fists of Thalmor|Fists of Thalmor]] are a military arm of the [[Online:Aldmeri Dominion|Aldmeri Dominion]]'s government. They enforce the decisions of the [[ON:Thalmor|Thalmor]], the Dominion's effective executive, and are not affiliated with the Dominion's normal army.<noinclude> 

Owing to their name, the Fists of Thalmor are sometimes confused with the Thalmor themselves. Some members of the Thalmor are unhappy with how that is affecting their perception by the public, and have proposed that the Fists be renamed to their previous name of Justiciars.

Online:Falinesti Faithful:
<noinclude>{{Trail|Factions}}[[File:ON-place-Falinesti Winter Site.jpg|thumb|The winter site]]</noinclude>
The [[Online:Falinesti Faithful|Falinesti Faithful]] are a group dedicated to the protection and tending of the four sites that the [[Online:Falinesti|Falinesti]] tree city travels between every season.<noinclude> 

Despite Falinesti having gone missing centuries ago, they still tend these sites in the hope that it will one day reappear. They have many theories as to why the city went missing, ranging from simply getting lost to having been stolen by a [[Lore:Daedric Princes|Daedric Prince]]. They object to the current efforts of the [[Online:Aldmeri Dominion|Aldmeri Dominion]] to excavate the sites for artifacts.

The [[Online:Gray Host|Gray Host]], also called the '''Verkarth Vampires''', are a group of ancient [[ON:Vampire (NPC)|vampire]]s, [[ON:Werewolf (NPC)|werewolves]], and other abominations.<noinclude> In the base game, they can appear as the final wave of enemies at [[ON:Dark Anchors|Dark Anchors]], where they are led by [[ON:King Styriche of Verkarth|King Styriche of Verkarth]]. Accompanying Styriche is [[ON:Fangaril|Fangaril]], an undead werewolf summoned from deep beneath [[ON:Cyrodiil|Cyrodiil]], and [[ON:Zayzahad|Zayzahad]], a powerful [[ON:Werebat|werebat]].

They can be once again be encountered in DLC and Chapter content as the main antagonists of the [[ON:Dark Heart of Skyrim|Dark Heart of Skyrim]]-themed content. This new Gray Host resents King Styriche for [[Online:My Beloved Siblings, the Exarchs|damning them]] to [[Online:Coldharbour|Coldharbour]], and instead follow [[ON:Rada al-Saran|Rada al-Saran]]. Members can be found during [[Online:Harrowstorms|Harrowstorm]] activities, where their souls are being pulled from Coldharbour and freed back into [[Lore:Nirn|Nirn]]. They are allied with the [[Online:Icereach Coven|Icereach Coven]], the [[ON:Draugrkin|Draugrkin]], the [[ON:Thorn Legion|Thorn Legion]]'s via [[ON:Lady Thorn|Lady Thorn]]'s allegiance, and the [[ON:Nighthollow Clan|Nighthollow Clan]] through an ancient pact made with [[ON:Lady Belain|Lady Belain]].

Online:Ghost People Tribe:
<noinclude>{{Trail|Factions}}{{Mod Header|Murkmire}} __NOTOC__
[[File:ON-npc-Veeskhleel.jpg|thumb|right|Some Veeskhleel in Blight Bog Sump.]]</noinclude>
The [[ON:Ghost People Tribe|Ghost People Tribe]], or ''"Veeskhleel"'' in [[Lore:Jel|Jel]], are an [[ON:Argonian|Argonian]] tribe in [[ON:Murkmire|Murkmire]] with a very dark reputation. Named for the pale sickly scales they share, they rarely venture from their homes in the [[ON:Deepmire|Deepmire]], leaving only under the cover of night to steal Argonian eggs and corpses. With the latter, the Veeskhleel offer the souls from the bodies they take to their [[Lore:Hist|Hist]].<noinclude>

Their latest endeavors have involved conducting experiments on stolen eggs in order to create a sort of twisted rebirth, known as Hollow, which then serve them. So far, only four of the experiments have been deemed somewhat successful: [[ON:Ojei|Ojei]], [[ON:Xul-Mot|Xul-Mot]], [[ON:Krona|Krona]], and [[ON:Tlaiuhticah|Tlaiuhticah]].

Online:Firstmages:
<noinclude>{{Trail|Factions}}</noinclude>
The [[ON:Firstmages|Firstmages]] are a group of [[ON:High Elf|High Elf]] mages residing within the [[Online:Aetherian Archive|Aetherian Archive]] since the [[Lore:First Era|First Era]]. It was here that they found the Great Source, which granted them long lives.<noinclude> 

When the [[Online:The Mage (Celestial)|Celestial Mage]] arrived during the [[Lore:Interregnum|Interregnum]], her very presence destroyed the Great Source. Now, many of the Firstmages worship the Mage, whom they call the Learned One, on the upper floors of the archive, which have been devastated by the Learned One's magic. The Learned One does not wish to be disturbed, and the Firstmages on the upper floors will defend her with their lives. 

The only Firstmages who value their lives over their magic are Firstmages [[Online:Firstmage Anirwen|Anirwen]], [[Online:Firstmage Arnure|Arnure]] and [[Online:Firstmage Earil|Earil]], who reside on the first floor of the archive.

==Ambient Dialogue==
The Ghostsong Clansmen at [[Online:Lost Valley Redoubt|Lost Valley Redoubt]] occasionally speak aloud.
:''"I wanted to go first, but Nathari said the strong must help the weak see things through."''
:''"The light … it pains me …"''
:''"The price must be paid. Do they not see that?"''
:''"Our work is only beginning. Do not forget why we are here!"''
:''"I know Nathari's right. She's been right about everything. But this is harder than I thought it would be."''
:''"I don't like these Gray Host cutters standing about and watching. They're not welcome here."''
:''"Something stirs in the depths. I can hear it calling to me."''
:''"I think it's going well. Don't you?"''
:''"They seek to rouse the Heart, do they? I should like to see that …"''
:''"[[Online:Nathari|Nathari]] had better be right about this. I thought we'd all hear Namira's voice by now."''
:''"I know. We can't stop now. We have to see this through to the end."''
:''"This is taking too long. The waiting isn't easy."''
:''"The price must be paid. Do they not see that?"''
:''"What will it be like, I wonder? To be raised up by the Spirit Queen?"''
:''"It seems as though I have waited all my life for this day."''
:''"I do not belong here anymore … let me rest …"''
:''"How I longed for this day. Soon all that we have given up will be repaid twofold."''
:''"The Spirit Queen is here. Can't you feel her presence in the shadows?"''
:''"What do you think? Could we add some Gray Host to the ritual? They're here, aren't they?"''
:''"I wish there was another way."''

<noinclude>{{Trail|Factions}}{{Mod Header|Dark Brotherhood}}</noinclude>
The [[Online:Fate-Bearers|Fate-Bearers]] are a group of prophetic [[ON:Dark Elf|Dark Elf]] assassins based at their shrine of the changing fates out of [[ON:Vvardenfell|Vvardenfell]]. They use the rare gift of sight to see what the future holds, eliminate targets that have the potential to cause unmitigated disasters. Good and evil have no bearings on their visions, but it is the actions of individuals they focus on.<noinclude>

A group of them is active in the [[ON:Gold Coast|Gold Coast]], and responsible for the deaths of many citizens, as well as threats to many others.

Evidently, while their visions are accurate, their actions are not infallible, as they seek to assassinate [[ON:Naryu Virian|Naryu Virian]] despite [[ON:Veya Releth|Veya Releth]] being the catalyst for impending doom.

[[ON:The Errants|The Errants]] are a gang of lowly criminals active in [[ON:The Shambles|The Shambles]] district of [[ON:Fargrave|Fargrave]]. As pointed out by several [[ON:Daedra|Daedric]] residents, the Errants form the largest population of mortals within the city, though they do little to help improve the reputation of the mortal community in the eyes of the Daedra.<noinclude>

They are one of the three gangs vying for control of The Shambles, alongside the [[ON:Invisible Web|Invisible Web]] and the [[ON:Vanquished|Vanquished]].

Online:Imperial Legion:
<noinclude>{{Trail|Factions}}{{incomplete}}</noinclude>
The [[Online:Imperial Legion|Imperial Legion]] is the main army of the [[Lore:Empire|Empire]] of [[ON:Cyrodiil|Cyrodiil]], or what remains of it. They are loyal to the one who sits on the [[Lore:Ruby Throne|Ruby Throne]], which is currently [[Online:Clivia Tharn|Clivia Tharn]], though [[Online:Mannimarco|Mannimarco]] is secretly the one from which their orders come from.<noinclude> Another Tharn, [[Online:Septima Tharn|Septima]], is the Magus-General of the [[Online:Seventh Legion|Seventh Legion]], which is currently on a campaign to conquer [[ON:Bangkorai|Bangkorai]].

During the [[Lore:Interregnum|Interregnum]], the Empire fell into disarray and the Imperial Legion gradually lost control of its provinces. As a result, a large Imperial military presence can only be found in various camps throughout Cyrodiil.

Owners of the [[ON:Imperial Edition|Imperial Edition]] of the game can play as the Imperial race. However, you will not be a member of the Imperial Legion and must join any of the three [[ON:Alliances|Alliances]] during character creation.
{{FMI}}
==Known Legions==
{{Bullet Link|Legion of the West Weald|An Imperial Legion from Colovia tasked with securing the recently-annexed South Weald for the [[Lore:Colovian Estates|Colovian Estates]].}}
{{Bullet Link|Legion Zero|A traitorous Imperial Legion within the [[Online:Imperial City|Imperial City]] that has sworn fealty to [[Online:Molag Bal|Molag Bal]], becoming [[Online:Mind-Shriven|Mind-Shriven]].}}
*'''Second Legion''' — Accompanied [[ON:Varen Aquilarios|Varen Aquilarios]] during the [[Lore:Colovian Revolt|Colovian Revolt]], and headquartered in peacetime in the vicinity of [[ON:Bruma|Bruma]]. The [[Online:Imperial War Mastiff|Imperial War Mastiff]] is their mascot and symbol.
*'''Fourth Legion''' — [[ON:Quintia Rullus|Quintia Rullus]] worked in the engineering auxiliary of this legion, operating trebuchets, before deserting.
*'''Fifth Legion''' — Led by [[ON:Report: Quality of Recruits|Captain Lampronius]], who was training new recruits. The [[ON:Fifth Legion Porter|Fifth Legion Porter]] is named for them.
*'''Sixth Legion''' — Little is known of the Sixth Legion, but member [[Online:Antonia Gratas|Antonia Gratas]] mentions it by name in her dialogue.
{{Bullet Link|Seventh Legion|One of the Imperial Legions, they have taken control of [[Online:Fallen Wastes|Southern Bangkorai]].}}
*'''Ninth Legion''' — Part of the first group of Imperial troops sent to Black Marsh, the legion was [[Online:The Lost Legion|lost]] in a [[Online:Tsofeer Cavern|cave]] in [[Online:Murkmire|Murkmire]].
{{Bullet Link|Shields of Senchal|(formerly the Thirteenth Legion) An Imperial Legion sent to help restore order after the Knahaten Flu had ravaged the area, defending the Khajiit as they rebuilt and formed a city council alongside them.}}
{{Bullet Link|Cygnus Irregulars|A Legion grudgingly helping the [[ON:Euraxians|Euraxians]] before defecting.}}

Additionally, several groups of soldiers with unknown legion affiliations can be encountered throughout Tamriel.

Online:House Ravenwatch:
<noinclude>{{Trail|Factions}}__NOTOC__[[File:ON-place-Ravenwatch Castle.jpg|thumb|right|Ravenwatch Castle]]</noinclude>
[[Online:House Ravenwatch|House Ravenwatch]], or often referred to as the '''Ravenwatch''', is a noble family of [[ON:High Rock|High Rock]] based out of [[Online:Ravenwatch Castle|Ravenwatch Castle]] in [[Online:Rivenspire|Rivenspire]]. House Ravenwatch was founded by [[Online:Count Verandis Ravenwatch|Count Verandis Ravenwatch]] after he left the [[Online:Gray Host|Gray Host]].<noinclude>

The members are mostly [[Online:Vampire (NPC)|vampires]], with the House serving as a refuge for them in the region. Following the disappearance of Verandis at the end of the zone's questline, [[Online:Adusa-daro|Adusa-daro]] and [[Online:Fennorian|Fennorian]] assume charge of the House, with [[Online:Gwendis|Gwendis]] as second-in-command.

You can opt to join House Ravenwatch at the conclusion of the [[ON:Dark Heart of Skyrim|Dark Heart of Skyrim]] storyline by earning the achievement [[ON:Taking up the Mantle|Taking up the Mantle]], which grants you the [[ON:Titles|title]] "of House Ravenwatch".

Online:House Telvanni:
<noinclude>{{Trail|Factions}}__NOTOC__</noinclude>
[[Online:House Telvanni|House Telvanni]] is one of the [[Lore:Great Houses|Great Houses]] of [[ON:Morrowind (province)|Morrowind]]. Out of all the Great Houses, they are the most well-versed in the affairs of magic, which, combined with their renowned isolation, puts them at odd with the general population. The House seat is [[ON:Sadrith Mora|Sadrith Mora]].<noinclude> 

They refused to join the [[Online:Ebonheart Pact|Ebonheart Pact]], partially on the grounds of slavery, as the [[Online:Argonian|Argonian]]s, which make up a large proportion of their slaves, were granted equal membership of the Pact and all Argonian slaves were to be released.

The affairs of the House are run by the Telvanni Council, which consists of five powerful Telvanni wizards, formally led by Archmagister [[Online:Nelos Otheri|Nelos Otheri]]. However, the councilors prefer not to be disturbed and do not usually act directly, but rather through intermediaries known as Mouths, who attend the council sessions in Sadrith Mora on their behalf.

For historical information, see the [[Lore:House Telvanni|lore article]].

[[Online:House Dres|House Dres]] is one of the [[Lore:Great Houses|Great Houses]] of [[Online:Morrowind (province)|Morrowind]]. They control the southeast of Morrowind from the city of [[Lore:Tear|Tear]]. This position allows them to act as the main slavers for the rest of the province.<noinclude> 

They were opposed to the [[Online:Ebonheart Pact|Ebonheart Pact]]'s terms, which freed all [[Online:Argonian|Argonian]] slaves. However, unlike the other three Great Houses which belong to the Pact, the Dres still keep non-Argonian slaves in the territories they control. They have strong ties to [[Online:House Indoril|House Indoril]]. The House is ruled by [[Online:Grandmaster Omin Dres|Grandmaster Omin Dres]] from his [[Online:Grandmaster's Palace|palace]] the house seat, [[Online:Kragenmoor|Kragenmoor]].

For historical information, see the [[Lore:House Dres|lore article]].

The [[Online:Iron Orcs|Iron Orcs]] are an isolated [[Online:Orc|Orcish]] civilization native to [[Online:Craglorn|Craglorn]]. They are known for their stone worship and their savage brutality, and often make their home in the [[Online:Nede|Nedic]] ruins that dot the region. They are culturally separate from other Orcs, and possess their own language.<noinclude> They tame [[ON:Troll|trolls]] and [[Online:Welwa|welwa]]s as war beasts, and primarily use iron arms and armor.

For historical information, see the [[Lore:Iron Orcs|lore article]].

Online:House Hlaalu:
<noinclude>{{Trail|Factions}}[[File:ON-place-Hlaalu Kinhouse.jpg|thumb|House Hlaalu kinhouse]][[File:ON-place-Rethan Manor.jpg|thumb|Rethan Manor, a Hlaalu mansion]] __NOTOC__</noinclude>
[[Online:House Hlaalu|House Hlaalu]] is one of the [[Lore:Great Houses|Great Houses]] of [[Online:Morrowind (province)|Morrowind]]. Their house seat, [[Online:Narsis|Narsis]], on the banks of [[Online:Lake Hlaalu|Lake Hlaalu]], is an important trade city. Their main priorities are business and trade, making compromise a way of life.<noinclude> As a result of that, they had no real objection to the [[Online:Ebonheart Pact|Ebonheart Pact]], rather they saw it as an opportunity to open more trading routes. 

Following a golden age under [[Online:Grandmaster Delmene Hlaalu|Grandmaster Delmene]] centuries ago, the Hlaalu are long past their prime and currently at their nadir, clinging to what little settlements they control including Narsis and [[ON:Seyda Neen|Seyda Neen]]. [[ON:House Redoran|House Redoran]] currently control [[ON:Balmora|Balmora]] and [[ON:Suran|Suran]], which are only built in the Hlaalu style as part of a construction contract.

[[Online:House Redoran|House Redoran]] is one of the five [[Lore:Great Houses|Great Houses]] of [[ON:Morrowind (province)|Morrowind]]. Owing to their traditions as a warrior clan, they gladly joined the [[ON:Ebonheart Pact|Ebonheart Pact]] and provide the vast majority of the [[ON:Dunmer|Dunmer]]'s soldiers. The House seat is the city of [[Lore:Blacklight|Blacklight]].<noinclude>

They live by the ideals of duty, gravity, and piety. Their loyalty is first to the [[Lore:Tribunal|Tribunal]], second to Great House Redoran, and third to Family and Clan. Redoran prize duty, honor, and piety above all else. They are deeply linked with the [[Online:Tribunal Temple (faction)|Tribunal Temple]], helping to enforce the Tribunal's will across Morrowind. [[Online:High Councilor Meriath|High Councilor Meriath]] rules as the House's Archmaster.

Online:Hollow Moon:
<noinclude>{{Trail|Factions}}[[File:ON-item-Hollow Moon Garb.jpg|thumb|right|Clothes denoting affiliation with the Hollow Moon]] __NOTOC__</noinclude>
The [[Online:Hollow Moon|Hollow Moon]] is a charitable organization of thieves operating at the [[ON:Redfur Trading Post|Redfur Trading Post]]. They steal from wealthy merchants and give what they take to those in need. Be it gold to buy food, silks to trade for other goods or gold to buy food or medicine for the sickly.<noinclude> 

The Hollow Moon often clashes with [[ON:Jode's Chariot|Jode's Chariot]], the local law enforcement group. The two organizations generally have mutual respect one another, as they both agree with the premise of giving to those in need. However, the Hollow Moon must still be light on their feet, as Jode's Chariot is contractually obligated to stop thieves by [[ON:Shan-ra|Shan-ra]], the leader of the merchants running the trading coster.

Agents of the organization will often give Hollow Moon Tokens to the infirm so their need is not questioned when they petition the group for aid.

You join the organization if you follow the related quest.

Online:Icereach Coven:
<noinclude>{{Trail|Factions}}</noinclude>
<noinclude>[[File:ON-banner-Icereach Coven.jpg|thumb|right|Icereach Coven Banner]]</noinclude>
<noinclude>{{About|the faction|the final boss fight in Icereach|Online:Icereach Coven (Boss)}}</noinclude>
The [[ON:Icereach Coven|Icereach Coven]] (also known as '''Icereach Clan''') are a group of [[ON:Reachmen|Reachman]] witches who are based in the island fortress on [[ON:Icereach|Icereach]], led by [[Online:Mother Ciannait|Mother Ciannait]]. During the rule of the [[Lore:Longhouse Emperors|Longhouse Emperor]] [[Online:Emperor Leovic|Leovic]], they served as his advisors until they were driven out of [[ON:Cyrodiil|Cyrodiil]] during [[Online:Varen Aquilarios|Varen]]'s [[Lore:Varen's Rebellion|Rebellion]], along with the rest of the Reachmen. They were further chased out of [[Online:Skyrim|Skyrim]], forcing them to return to their island home.<noinclude> 

In recent times, they drew attention to themselves with the unnatural storms brewing on the [[Lore:Sea of Ghosts|Sea of Ghosts]]. The [[ON:Nord|Nord]] forces sent to investigate quickly found that the Coven had regained strength and the patronage of an unknown benefactor.

The Icereach Coven is also heavily involved in the ongoing troubles in [[ON:Western Skyrim|Western Skyrim]], where it is eventually revealed that they are working towards the resurgence of the [[ON:Gray Host|Gray Host]], with the hope that their efforts will be rewarded by the ancient order wiping out the Nords and giving the land back to [[ON:The Reach|The Reach]]. They are also the ones responsible for creating the devastating [[ON:Harrowstorms|Harrowstorms]] all over Western Skyrim, The Reach and [[ON:Blackreach|Blackreach]].

Online:Mages Guild:
{{Trail|Factions}}{{About|the faction|one of the various places|{{pl|Category:Online-Places|Category:Online-Places|from{{=}}Mages Guild#mw-pages}}}} The [[Online:Mages Guild|Mages Guild]] is an organization dedicated to magical learning with a presence all throughout [[ON:Tamriel|Tamriel]]. It was founded by [[ON:Vanus Galerion|Vanus Galerion]] following his departure from the [[ON:Psijic Order|Psijic Order]]. To join, go to any Mages Guild hall and speak with [[Online:Curinure|Curinure]], [[Online:Nemarc|Nemarc]], or [[Online:Rudrasa|Rudrasa]] (regardless of your alliance) and tell them you're ready to join. To gain reputation with them, you must bring them lost tomes of [[Online:Shalidor's Library|Tamrielic lore]]. Each lorebook adds five points to the Mages Guild skill line, and an increasing number of points is required to gain a rank. Good relations with the guild can earn you new skills, perks, and abilities. The Mages Guild quest line is focused around the Daedric Prince of Madness, [[Online:Sheogorath|Sheogorath]]. The Mages Guild, along with the [[Online:Fighters Guild|Fighters Guild]], is also at the head of an assault into [[Online:Coldharbour|Coldharbour]] which takes place at the culmination of the [[Online:Story Quests|Alliance Storyline]] and [[Online:Main Quest|Main Quest]]. Note that progression through the Mages Guild quest line does not affect this in any way. {{FMI}} ==Quests== *Joining Quests :{{ESO Alliances |Dominion={{Quest Link|Curinure's Invitation}} |Covenant={{Quest Link|Nemarc's Invitation}} |Pact={{Quest Link|Rudrasa's Invitation}}}} *{{Quest Link|Long Lost Lore}} *{{Quest Link|Simply Misplaced}} *{{Quest Link|Circus of Cheerful Slaughter (quest)}} *{{Quest Link|Chateau of the Ravenous Rodent (quest)}} *{{Quest Link|The Mad God's Bargain}} *{{Quest Link|The Arch-Mage's Boon}} ===Public Dungeon Dailies=== These quests are available after joining the Mages Guild, and are offered by [[ON: Alvur Baren|Alvur Baren]] located within the Mages Guild buildings of Elden Root (Grahtwood), Mournhold (Deshaan), and Wayrest (Stormhaven). These quests will send you to a random public dungeon to retrieve an artifact associated with Sheogorath. These quests can be shared with other members of your group, so it is possible to do up to 15 of these quests in a day. These quests will give Mages Guild reputation, as well as a small box of rewards. Online:Order of the Hidden Moon:
<noinclude>{{Trail|Factions}}{{Mod Header|Elsweyr}}
[[File:ON-quest-Path of the Hidden Moon 04.jpg|thumb|right|Mazza-Mirri and Shando-ri]]</noinclude>
The [[ON:Order of the Hidden Moon|Order of the Hidden Moon]] was an ancient [[ON:Khajiit|Khajiit]] order dedicated to [[Lore:Azurah|Azurah]], based in what became the [[ON:Ashen Scar|Ashen Scar]]. They were responsible for dealing with the [[ON:Dro-m'Athra|dro-m'Athra]], by using a form of necromancy which would allow the dark spirits to redeem their corrupted souls and to pass through The Crossing. The [[Lore:Moonlight Blade|Moonlight Blade]] was the special weapon of their order, blessed by Azurah herself.<noinclude>

In earlier times, members of the Hidden Moon would be partnered with [[Online:Moon-Singers|Moon-Singers]], to use the latter's songs to fight the [[ON:Dro-m'Athra|dro-m'Athra]]. However, this fell out of practice after the rise of the [[ON:Rajaska|Rajaska]], a Pride of fallen singers led by [[ON:Ravith-morna|Ravith-morna]]. This dire threat was beaten back by the actions of hadaliit [[ON:Zerith-var|Zerith-var]].

At some point in the [[Lore:First Era|First Era]], a schism occurred when one of its adepts, [[Online:Arum-Khal|Arum-Khal]] grew dissatisfied, renouncing Azurah and sought to take power for himself. Many of his fellow adepts followed him and the resulting civil war destroyed much of the temple complex and surrounding area. The survivors were unable to slay the now-lich Arum-Khal and instead sealed his spirit within the [[ON:Hidden Moon Crypts|crypt]]s. The Order became a memory and legend, until the time around {{Year|2E 582}}, where Arum-Khal's awakening caused the [[ON:Undead|undead]] of the Ashen Scar to rise as well. However, some spirits of the Order still remain in the ruins, ready to stop the powerful Dro-m'Athra Lich once and for all.

Remnants of the Order can be found in other places around [[ON:Northern Elsweyr|Northern Elsweyr]], such as the [[ON:Nightmare Plateau|Nightmare Plateau]], a former Hidden Moon shrine where the Dro-m'Athra [[ON:Zalsheem|Zalsheem]] was sealed.

Online:Nighthollow Clan:
<noinclude>{{Trail|Factions}}[[File:ON-banner-Nighthollow Clan.png|250px|right]]{{Mod Header|Markarth}}</noinclude>
The [[Online:Nighthollow Clan|Nighthollow Clan]] are an ancient clan of [[ON:Nede|Nedic]] [[Online:Vampire (NPC)|vampires]] who once ruled [[ON:The Reach|the Reach]] above from their [[ON:Nighthollow Keep|keep]] in the depths of [[ON:Blackreach: Arkthzand Cavern|Blackreach]], and were dubbed the '''Night Lords''' by the ancestors of modern [[ON:Reachmen|Reachfolk]].

After the fall of the [[Online:Dwemer|Dwarven]] city-states, thanks to the [[Lore:Aetherium|Aetherium]] Wars, the Nighthollow Clan took control of the [[Lore:Dark Heart|Dark Heart]]. However, over time, they became overly reliant on its void energy for sustenance and, as a result, were no longer able to gain nourishment through blood. 

Eventually, the power of the Dark Heart would wane, and would only be reserved for the inner circle of the Nighthollow Clan, leaving those lower in the hierarchy suffering from starvation. The Nighthollow Clan would, in time, lose their influence and become reduced to mere bedtime stories to the dwellers of the Reach.<noinclude> 

In an effort to regain their power, [[ON:Lady Belain|Lady Belain]] made a pact with [[Online:Rada al-Saran|Rada al-Saran]] and his [[Online:Gray Host|Gray Host]] centuries ago, allying the clan with the Gray Host in exchange for obtaining their help in figuring out a way to bring the Dark Heart back to its full potential.

They lent their name to the Yokudan refugees who settled [[Online:Hammerfell|Hammerfell]] in the wake of the invasion and became the [[Online:Redguard|Redguard]]s.<noinclude>

The Ra Gada can be encountered in a vision of the past at [[Online:Ash'abah Pass|Ash'abah Pass]]. A group of Ra Gada, the [[Online:Anka-Ra|Anka-Ra]], are seen in [[Online:Craglorn|Craglorn]] and are documented on the related page.

Online:Resolutes of Stendarr:
<noinclude>{{Mod Header|Dark Brotherhood}}</noinclude>
<noinclude>{{Trail|Factions}}</noinclude>
The [[Online:Resolutes of Stendarr|Resolutes of Stendarr]] are a group of [[Lore:Stendarr|Stendarr]] devotees who have sworn to help the sick and protect the weak. The Resolutes consist of holy warriors and individuals who are talented in healing magicks. Their healers are encouraged by their leaders to use those magicks unsparingly. The Resolutes of Stendarr Pin wear [[Online:Contraband/Wardrobe Accessories#Resolutes of Stendarr Pin|silver pins]] to identify themselves as members of the organization.<noinclude>

The Resolutes seek to hunt what they call the Four Abominations: [[Online:Daedra|Daedra]], [[Online:Werewolf (NPC)|manbeasts]], [[Online:Vampire|vampires]] and [[Online:Undead|risen corpses]]. The Resolutes hold that these abominations are unnatural, and seek to drive them from [[Online:Tamriel|Tamriel]] in Stendarr's name. 

The [[Online:Hireling (Enchanting)|enchanter hireling]], [[Online:Melina Cassel|Melina Cassel]], learns this the hard way in her [[Online:Melina Cassel#Correspondence|hireling correspondence mails]]. The Four Abominations abhor the light; thus the Resolutes believe that Stendarr gifted those who invoke his name with the ability to clothe themselves in an aura of blessed light. The Resolutes hold that Stendarr's faithful have adapted the gift of light to smite their enemies, as well as defend and heal their allies. [[Online:Templar|Templar]] skills are described in a [[Online:Aura of the Righteous|book]] published by the Resolutes on the subject of Stendarr's gift to the righteous.

Online:Pale Watch:
<noinclude>{{Mod Header|Orsinium}}{{Trail|Factions}}[[File:ON-place-Watcher's Hold.jpg|thumb|Watcher's Hold]]</noinclude>
The [[Online:Pale Watch|Pale Watch]] is a rogue [[ON:Breton|Breton]] knightly order found inside [[ON:Watcher's Hold|Watcher's Hold]] in [[ON:Wrothgar|Wrothgar]]. The order was originally stationed in the hold by King Maxevian of [[ON:Daggerfall|Daggerfall]], at a time of great hostilities between the Breton and the [[ON:Orc|Orcs]].

Following the [[Lore:Siege of Orsinium|fall of the first Orsinium]], the Pale Watch remained at their post. Their hatred of the Orcs remained well into the rebuilding of the second [[ON:Orsinium|Orsinium]]. Rudderless and angered at seeing the Orcs rebounding after the loss of their first city, the knights have turned to banditry and killing of Orc travelers.<noinclude>

Now that the Bretons and Orcs have become allies under the [[ON:Daggerfall Covenant|Daggerfall Covenant]], this has even led to [[ON:High King Emeric|High King Emeric]] to [[ON:Offer of Amnesty|contact]] them to ask to cease their hostilities, lest they be destroyed.

Online:Psijic Order:
<noinclude>{{Mod Header|Summerset}}{{Trail|Factions}}[[File:ON-banner-Psijic Order.png|100px|right|Banner of the Order]]</noinclude>
The [[ON:Psijic Order|Psijic Order]] is a mysterious and ancient order of powerful mages based on the isle of [[Lore:Artaeum|Artaeum]], geographically part of the [[Lore:Summerset Isles|Summerset Isles]]. As the island disappeared from [[ON:Tamriel|Tamriel]] over 350 years ago, around when former member [[ON:Vanus Galerion|Vanus Galerion]] formed the [[ON:Mages Guild|Mages Guild]], the Order has rarely ever been seen.<noinclude>

The Order formerly occupied the island of [[Online:Dranil Kir|Dranil Kir]], and a scrying device known as an [[Lore:Obscuros|Obscuros]] located on it is sought by [[Online:Lilatha|Lilatha]], the master of the glazing glass. After [[Online:Daedric War Storyline|Nocturnal's plot]] in the [[ON:Clockwork City|Clockwork City]] is thwarted, [[ON:Sotha Sil|Sotha Sil]] tells [[ON:Divayth Fyr|Divayth Fyr]] that he will inform the Psijics so that they can prepare for a future threat.

It is a joinable faction in the [[Online:Summerset (Chapter)|Summerset]] [[ON:Chapters|Chapter]]. To join the Psijic Order, you must first complete the first Summerset zone story quest in [[ON:Shimmerene|Shimmerene]], [[ON:The Queen's Decree|The Queen's Decree]]. You will then gain access to Artaeum. Speak with [[On:Loremaster Celarus|Loremaster Celarus]] in [[ON:Ceporah Tower|Ceporah Tower]] to formally join the Psijic Order. 

If you somehow manage to transport to Artaeum by other means (e.g. teleporting to a player or their [[ON:Grand Psijic Villa|Grand Psijic Villa]]) without having completed The Queen's Decree, then Loremaster Celarus will not be present, even if you can see other players talking to someone you can't see. All you will be able to do is discover the Artaeum wayshrine to provide easier access to Artaeum in the future. You may still acquire the Psijic Order skill line by spending Crowns, if another character on your account has completed it.

For historical information about the Psijic Order, see the [[Lore:Psijic Order|lore article]].

==Chapters==
Roister's Club has its chapters scattered all across the Tamriel. One chapter of the club can be found in every base game zone, with exception of [[ON:Craglorn|Craglorn]], [[ON:Coldharbour|Coldharbour]], [[ON:Stros M'Kai|Stros M'Kai]], [[ON:Betnikh|Betnikh]], [[ON:Bleakrock Isle|Bleakrock Isle]], [[ON:Bal Foyen|Bal Foyen]] and [[ON:Khenarthi's Roost|Khenarthi's Roost]]. One chapter can be also found in each of the [[ON:Chapters|Chapter]] zones, with exception of the [[ON:High Isle|High Isle]], where three chapters can be found. There is no Roister's Club chapter in any of the [[ON:DLC|DLC]] zones, with the exception of [[ON:Galen|Galen]]. There is no Roister's Club chapter in [[ON:Artaeum|Artaeum]], [[ON:Blackreach|Blackreach]] and [[ON:Apocrypha|Apocrypha]]. Every chapter has three players of varied Tribute rank, except for the Gonfalon Bay, where ten novice players can be found instead. Tribute players can also be found in [[ON:Grandvache's Gambling Parlor|Grandvache's Gambling Parlor]] during the [[ON:An Eye for an Eye|An Eye for an Eye]], but this location is not considered a chapter of the Roister's Club.

Online:Items:
{{Trail}}[[Category:Online-Items| ]]{{TOCright}}
The Elder Scrolls Online is full of '''items''' both magical and mundane. The articles listed here provide information on the items in the game. For the game systems which manage items, see [[Online:Inventory|Inventory]] and [[Online:Collections|Collections]].

==Finding Items==
Depending upon whether you are looking for a specific item or just browsing for general information, there are several different ways to navigate through the many item-related pages.

===Search===
If you know the exact name of the specific item you want to find, type its name into the search box at the left-hand side of the page and then click on the magnifying glass image or press the Enter key on your keyboard.

===Categories===
Within the category '''[[:Category:Online-Items|Online-Items]]''' are many subcategories listing nearly every item in the game by function.  If you don't know the exact spelling of a specific item, browsing through one of the categories may help you to find it.

===General Articles on Items===
Most of these articles provide general information on various types of items, and also include lists of the mundane (non-enchanted and widely available) varieties of the items.
*[[Online:Alchemy Ingredients|Alchemy Ingredients]]: A complete list of alchemical solvents and reagents
*[[Online:Armor|Armor]]: Base unenchanted armor
*[[Online:Artifacts|Artifacts]]: Unique items that grant their wielders special powers
*[[Online:Blacksmithing Materials|Blacksmithing Materials]]: A complete list of ores, ingots, and tempers
*[[Online:Books|Books]]: All books in the game

*[[Online:Contraband|Contraband]]: Stolen items which exist only to sell to a [[Online:Fences|Fence]]

*[[Online:Crafting Motifs|Crafting Motifs]]: A list of all crafting motifs and their associated styles
*[[Online:Currency|Currency]]: The types of currencies in the game
*[[Online:Disguises|Disguises]]: Cosmetic outfits which cause certain enemies to become passive
*[[Online:Drinks|Drinks]]: Brewed beverages that provide temporary benefits
*[[Online:Food|Food]]: Cooked meals that can provide beneficial effects

Online:Provisioning Ingredients:
{{Trail|Items}}{{TOCright|limit=2}}
'''Provisioning Ingredients''' are materials used in [[Online:Provisioning|Provisioning]], necessary for cooking food and brewing drinks. Ingredients come in three types, base ingredients, medium ingredients, and improvement ingredients. Every [[Online:Recipes|recipe]] contains from one to three base ingredients. Medium ingredients are used when creating level 10 and up provisions of {{ESO Quality Color|f|Fine}} quality and level 20 and up provisions of {{ESO Quality Color|s|Superior}} quality. Improvement ingredients are used only for making {{ESO Quality Color|e|Epic}} quality food and beverages.

Provisioning was significantly modified with Update 6. For the list of ingredients used before the update, see [[Online:Provisioning Ingredients/deprecated|Provisioning Ingredients/deprecated]]. A table detailing the ingredient conversion can be found [[Online:Provisioning Ingredients/deprecated#Provisioning Revamp Ingredient Conversion|here]].

Online:Blacksmithing Materials:
{{Trail|Items}} There are four types of materials involved in [[ON:Blacksmithing|Blacksmithing]]: Ores, Ingots, Tempers, and Gems. Ores are the raw materials that can be found in the world in mineral deposits. By themselves they cannot be used, but they may be refined into Ingots at any armor crafting station. Unlocking the "Plentiful Harvest" and "Master Gatherer" perks in the Craft [[Online:Champion#Craft|Champion]] tree will also provide bonuses when harvesting. There is a small chance of producing tempers when refining raw materials. The ores you find are determined by your character's level and your [[Online:Metalworking|Metalworking]] level—if you are level 40 with a Metalworking level of 2, you will find both High Iron Ore and Dwarven Ore out in the world. Ingots are used to make [[ON:Heavy Armor|Heavy Armor]] as well as all bladed or blunt melee [[Online:Weapons|weapons]]. Tempers can be used to improve existing armor or weapons. Tempers can be obtained by deconstructing existing armor sets. Ores and tempers can both be acquired through [[ON:Miner Hireling|Miner Hireling]] mails. Ingots and tempers can be obtained as rewards for completing [[Online:Blacksmith Writ|Blacksmith Writs]]. Gems are used to craft weapons and armor with traits, provided that trait has been researched on that piece. Online:Clothing Materials:
{{Trail|Items}} There are four types of materials involved in [[ON:Clothing|Clothing]]: Raw Materials, Processed Materials, Tannins, and Gems. Unlocking the "Plentiful Harvest" and "Master Gatherer" perks in the Craft [[Online:Champion#Craft|Champion]] tree will also provide bonuses when harvesting. There is a small chance of producing tannins when refining raw materials. Processed materials and tannins can be obtained as rewards for completing [[Online:Clothier Writ|Clothier Writs]]. Gems can be used to craft armor with traits, provided that trait has been researched on that piece. Online:Jewelry:
{{trail|Items}}__NOTOC__
'''Jewelry''' comprises two types of items: Necklaces and Rings. You may wear two rings and one necklace. Before [[ON:Update 18|Update 18]] and the introduction of [[ON:Jewelry Crafting|Jewelry Crafting]], jewelry was the one major class of gear that could not be crafted or deconstructed/researched. It had to be found or purchased from vendors. The only option for customization that existed was that you could [[ON:Enchanting|enchant]] some jewelry with the right kind of Glyphs. Now, those with access to the [[Online:Summerset (Chapter)|Summerset]] chapter can craft, deconstruct, research, and transmute jewelry, though jewelry found before this update may not be deconstructed. All rings and necklaces are identical in appearance in your inventory (they do not appear on your character at all), but they may be of varying level, which affects their Traits as well as the level of Enchantment they may take.

==Traits==
Before Update 18, Jewelry could not be researched to learn its traits. However, each piece of Jewelry typically came with one trait already on it. This remains true for the most part. The standard traits are:
*'''[[ON:Robust|Robust]]''' — Increase {{ESO Stamina Link|Max}} by X.
*'''[[ON:Arcane|Arcane]]''' — Increase {{ESO Magicka Link|Max}} by X.
*'''[[ON:Healthy (trait)|Healthy]]''' — Increase {{ESO Health Link|Max}} by X.
*'''[[ON:Ornate|Ornate]]''' — Increase sell price by X%.

The [[Online:Summerset (Chapter)|Summerset]] chapter provided the new [[ON:Jewelry Crafting|Jewelry Crafting]] skill line, which added six new traits in addition to making the Robust, Arcane, and Healthy traits researchable and craftable. These traits cannot be found in most places, but are only available via specific activities. The new traits are:

*'''[[ON:Bloodthirsty|Bloodthirsty]]''' — Increase execute damage by 10% when enemy is below 25%
** Rare reward from weekly [[ON:Trials|Trials]] quests.
*'''[[ON:Harmony|Harmony]]''' — Increase the effectiveness of any Synergies by 35%
** Rare find in [[ON:Undaunted|Undaunted]] chests.
*'''[[ON:Infused|Infused]]''' — Increase the effect of the enchantment by 60%
**Rare find in [[ON:Psijic Portals|Psijic Portals]].
**A necklace can be obtained as a reward for completing the quest [[ON:The Long Way Home|The Long Way Home]].
*'''[[ON:Triune|Triune]]''' — Increase Maximum Health, Maximum Magicka and Maximum Stamina by 435
**Rare reward from daily board quests in [[ON:Cyrodiil|Cyrodiil]].
**A ring can be obtained as a reward for completing the quest [[ON:Uxark's Treasure|Uxark's Treasure]].
**A ring can be obtained as a reward for completing the quest [[ON:A Father's Pride|A Father's Pride]]
*'''[[ON:Protective|Protective]]''' — Increase Physical Resistance by 1844
**Reward for completing major quest lines in [[ON:Summerset|Summerset]] ([[ON:Psijic Order|Psijic Order]] for necklace and main quest for ring).
**A necklace can be obtained as a reward for completing the quest [[ON:Reformatory Rescue|Reformatory Rescue]].
**A ring can be obtained as a reward for completing the quest [[ON:The All Flags Curse|The All Flags Curse]].
*'''[[ON:Swift|Swift]]''' — Increase Movement Speed by 6%
**Rare reward for [[ON:Jewelry Crafting Writ|Jewelry Crafting Writs]].

They have sacked and occupied the town of [[Online:Saintsport|Saintsport]].<noinclude> They are hostile and will attack anyone who comes near. A ''[[ON:Letter to Headman Bhosek|Letter to Headman Bhosek]]'' claims that the Sea Drakes have held Stros M'Kai's only lighthouse for over a year. During that time, 18 ships have run upon the rocks. [[ON:Captain Helane|Captain Helane]] has had her crew sabotage the lighthouse to plunder the ships that inevitably wreck without the lighthouse to guide them.

Online:Ritual of Mara:
<noinclude>{{Trail}}{{Mod Header|Crown Store|Imperial Edition}}[[File:ON-activity-Ritual of Mara.jpg|thumb|right|The Ritual of Mara]]__NOTOC__
The '''Ritual of Mara''' can be performed at any [[Online:Shrine to Mara|Shrine to Mara]]. It requires a {{Item Link|Pledge of Mara|id=44903|level=1|quality=5}}, a [[ON:Crown Store|Crown Store]] item that can also be obtained by purchasing the [[Online:Imperial Edition|Imperial Edition]]. The pledge must be quickslotted to activate, and will send your partner a notification to begin the ritual. Should they accept, both of you will receive a {{Item Link|Ring of Mara|id=44904|level=1|quality=5}}, which results in an experience bonus when you [[ON:Grouping|group]] together.

Players who [[Online:PC/Mac_Store#Tamriel_Unlimited_and_Account_Copy_for_Consoles|copied their account]] to console after using a Pledge of Mara on PC were allowed to keep their rings, but the experience bonus will only work on console if their partners also purchased an account copy.

Online:Nirncrux:
{{Trail|Items}}
'''Nirncrux''', commonly called red brittle, shake stone or miner's bane, is a red stone found only in [[Online:Craglorn|Craglorn]]. In its raw form, it releases a poisonous gas when cracked which can cause symptoms ranging from nausea, body tremors, and disorientation to convulsions, slurred speech, memory loss and death. Ancient [[Online:Nede|Nede]]s discovered how to use it to harness the power of the stars, and the [[Online:Upper Craglorn|Upper Craglorn]] storyline focuses on stopping the [[Online:Scaled Court|Scaled Court]] and the [[Online:Iron Orcs|Iron Orcs]] from rediscovering these secrets.

As a reward for questing in Upper Craglorn, you can earn a piece of gear with the unique Nirnhoned [[Online:Traits|trait]]. Once [[Online:Traits#Research|researched]], Nirnhoned weapons and armor can be crafted using {{Item Link|Potent Nirncrux|id=56863|quality=1}} or {{Item Link|Fortified Nirncrux|id=56862|quality=1}}, respectively. These materials can rarely be obtained by harvesting any crafting [[ON:Nodes|node]] in Craglorn. They can also be obtained from Heavy Sacks in the region, or from killing creatures that drop medium armor [[Online:Clothing Materials|clothing materials]] such as [[ON:Welwa|welwa]]. Nirncrux materials were originally limited to Upper Craglorn, but can now be found throughout the entire zone.

In addition to the crafting aspect, access to Stable Nirncrux can be earned by completing a group event at an [[Online:Iron Orc Nirncrux Mine|Iron Orc Nirncrux Mine]]. Activating Stable Nirncrux will grant the [[Online:Nirncrux Infusion|Nirncrux Infusion]] Physical Resistance buff for 1 hour.

Online:Recipes:
{{Trail|Items}}{{TOCright}}
There are 570 '''recipes''' to be collected in total: 288 [[Online:Food Recipes|food recipes]] and 282 [[Online:Beverage Recipes|beverage recipes]], including 258 {{ESO Quality Color|f|'''Standard'''}} recipes, 230 {{ESO Quality Color|s|'''Difficult'''}} recipes, 68 {{ESO Quality Color|e|'''Complex'''}} recipes, and 14 {{ESO Quality Color|l|'''Legendary'''}} recipes. Learning a recipe will remove it from your inventory, but in exchange, you will learn how to craft its meal indefinitely. [[ON:Chefs|Chefs]] and [[ON:Brewers|Brewers]] sell food and drink recipes respectively for large amounts of gold. Alternatively, recipes can be found in trunks, wardrobes, desks, nightstands, and the likes. The recipe received when you loot a container is based on your level and your [[Online:Recipe Improvement|Recipe Improvement]] rank. To cook food or brew a beverage, you must have the required [[Online:Provisioning|provisioning]] skills. If you do, simply visit a cooking fire found in most towns to begin combining [[Online:Provisioning Ingredients|ingredients]]. Eating food and drinking beverages temporarily gives your [[Online:Attributes|attributes]] a bonus when consumed. However, food and beverage bonuses do not stack, so you have to pick only one.

There are two skills required to craft food and beverages.
*[[Online:Provisioning|Recipe Improvement]] ranges from 1 to 6 and lets you make higher Level-Requirement meals.
*[[Online:Provisioning|Recipe Quality]] ranges from 1 to 4 and allows you to craft {{ESO Quality Color|f|'''Standard'''}}, {{ESO Quality Color|s|'''Difficult'''}}, {{ESO Quality Color|e|'''Complex'''}}, and {{ESO Quality Color|l|'''Legendary'''}} versions of recipes.

For the full list of recipes see the [[Online:Food Recipes|Food Recipes]], [[Online:Beverage Recipes|Beverage Recipes]], and [[Online:Special Recipes|Special Recipes]] pages.

== Food Recipes ==
{{About||a full list|Food Recipes}}
===Standard Recipes===
* '''{{ESO Quality Color|f|Meat Dishes}}''' (increase Max <font color="red">Health</font>): meat + [ medium ingredient ]
* '''{{ESO Quality Color|f|Fruit Dishes}}''' (increase Max <font color="blue">Magicka</font>): fruit + [ medium ingredient ]
* '''{{ESO Quality Color|f|Vegetable Dishes}}''' (increase Max <font color="green">Stamina</font>): vegetable + [ medium ingredient ]
Dishes of {{ESO Quality Color|f|Fine Quality}} can be cooked for all levels.

===Difficult Recipes===
* '''{{ESO Quality Color|s|Savouries}}''' (increase Max <font color="red">Health</font> and Max <font color="blue">Magicka</font>): meat + fruit + [ medium ingredient ]
* '''{{ESO Quality Color|s|Ragout}}''' (increase Max <font color="red">Health</font> and Max <font color="green">Stamina</font>): meat + vegetable + [ medium ingredient ]
* '''{{ESO Quality Color|s|Entremet}}''' (increase Max <font color="blue">Magicka</font> and Max <font color="green">Stamina</font>): fruit + vegetable + [ medium ingredient ]
Dishes of {{ESO Quality Color|s|Superior Quality}} can be cooked for levels 10 and up.

===Complex Recipes===
* '''{{ESO Quality Color|e|Gourmet}}''' (increase Max <font color="red">Health</font>, Max <font color="blue">Magicka</font> and Max <font color="green">Stamina</font>): meat + fruit + vegetable + improvement ingredient
Dishes of {{ESO Quality Color|e|Epic Quality}} can be cooked for levels 20 and up.

===Delicacies===
* '''{{ESO Quality Color|l|Delicacies}}''' have unique combinations of bonuses  that cannot be found elsewhere, and often require ingredients not used in other Provisioning recipes. These cover the full range of qualities, with 5 {{ESO Quality Color|f|Standard}} recipes, 9 {{ESO Quality Color|s|Difficult}} recipes, 2 {{ESO Quality Color|e|Complex}} recipes, and 7 {{ESO Quality Color|l|Legendary}} recipes.
Delicacies have no level requirement and can be consumed at any level.

{{trail|Items}}
Elder Scrolls Online has many types of '''Currency'''.

==Unrestricted Currency==
The following currencies can be freely withdrawn or deposited into your account-wide bank. They do not take up inventory space.
*[[File:ON-icon-Gold.png|16px|link=]] '''[[ON:Gold|Gold]]''' — The main currency, used to pay for most services and trade with players
*[[File:ON-icon-Alliance Points.png|16px|link=]] '''[[Online:Alliance Points|Alliance Points]]''' — A currency earned for participation in the [[Online:Alliance War|Alliance War]] and [[ON:Battlegrounds|Battlegrounds]]
*[[File:ON-icon-Tel Var.png|16px|link=]] '''[[Online:Tel Var Stones|Tel Var Stones]]''' — A currency earned and spent in the [[Online:Imperial City|Imperial City]]
*[[File:ON-icon-Writ Voucher.png|16px|link=]] '''[[Online:Writ Vouchers|Writ Vouchers]]''' — A currency accepted by [[Online:Mastercraft Mediators|Mastercraft Mediators]], earned for completing [[ON:Master Writ|Master Writ]]s

==Restricted Currency==
The following currencies are locked and account-wide. They do not take up inventory space. They cannot be deposited or withdrawn from the bank. Most items purchased with Crowns are able to be gifted to other players, but Crowns cannot be gifted directly.
*[[File:ON-icon-Archival Fortunes.png|16px|link=]] '''[[Online:Archival Fortunes|Archival Fortunes]]''' — A currency used in the [[Online:Infinite Archive|Infinite Archive]]
*[[File:ON-icon-store-Crowns.png|16px|link=]] '''[[Online:Crown Store|Crowns]]''' — A currency used in the [[Online:Crown Store|Crown Store]]
*[[File:ON-icon-store-Crown Gems.png|16px|link=]] '''[[Online:Crown Gems|Crown Gems]]''' — A currency tied to [[Online:Crown Crates|Crown Crates]]
*[[File:ON-icon-Outfit Change Token.png|16px|link=]] '''[[ON:Outfit Change Token|Outfit Change Token]]s''' — A currency used at Outfit Stations, usually purchased from the Gold Coast Bazaar
*[[File:ON-icon-store-Seals_of_Endeavor.png|16px|link=]] '''[[ON:Seals|Seals]]''' — A currency tied to the Crown Crate items and earned through the Tamriel Tome challenges, renamed from [[ON:Seals of Endeavor|Seals of Endeavor]]
*[[File:ON-icon-Tome Points.png|20px|link=]]'''[[Online:Tome Points|Tome Points]]''' — A currency used with [[ON:Tamriel Tomes|Tamriel Tomes]] to unlock pages for more rewards, earned by completing challenges.
*[[File:ON-icon-Cache of Tome Points.png|20px|link=]]'''[[ON:Cache of Tome Points|Cache of Tome Points]]''' — earned from bonuses of purchasing the premium version of a Tamriel Tome. A cache will contain {{ESO TP|2,000}}
*[[File:ON-icon-Premium Tome Token.png|20px|link=]]'''[[Online:Premium Tome Tokens|Premium Tome Tokens]]''' — earned from the [[Online:ESO Plus|ESO Plus]] subscription, can be used to unlock the premium+bonus rewards for any Tamriel Tome.
*[[File:ON-icon-Transmute Crystal.png|16px|link=]] '''[[ON:Transmute Crystals|Transmute Crystals]]''' — A currency used to transmute the traits of equipment, earned from various activities (e.g. [[Online:Undaunted|Undaunted]] pledges)
*[[File:ON-icon-currency-Undaunted Keys.png|16px|link=]] '''[[ON:Undaunted Keys|Undaunted Keys]]''' — A currency used to purchase items from the Undaunted [[ON:Pledge Masters|Pledge Master]]s
*[[File:ON-icon-quest-Daedric Embers.png|16px|link=]] '''[[ON:Imperial Fragments|Imperial Fragments]]''' — A currency used to purchase items from the [[ON:Trophy Vaults|Trophy Vaults]] vendor in the [[ON:Imperial City|Imperial City]]
*[[File:ON-icon-Trade Bars.png|16px|link=]] '''[[ON:Trade Bars|Trade Bars]]''' — A currency used to purchase items from the [[ON:Gold Coast Bazaar|Gold Coast Bazaar]], replaced the [[File:ON-icon-Event Ticket.png|16px|link=]] '''[[Online:Event Tickets|Event Tickets]]''' upon release and '''cannot''' be purchased from Crown Store

Service Tokens are only visible on the character select screen and can only be used from there. They are usually purchased from the Crown Store
* [[File:ON-icon-store-Alliance Change Token.png|16px|link=]] '''Alliance Change Tokens''' — A token used to change the alliance your character is aligned to
* [[File:ON-icon-store-Appearance Change Token.png|16px|link=]] '''Appearance Change Tokens''' — A token used to change your character's appearance
* [[File:ON-icon-store-Name Change Token.png|16px|link=]] '''Name Change Tokens''' — A token used to change your character's name
* [[File:ON-icon-store-Race Change Token.png|16px|link=]] '''Race Change Tokens''' — A token used to change your character's race

Online:Jewelry Crafting Materials:
{{Trail|Items}} There are four types of materials involved in [[ON:Jewelry Crafting|Jewelry Crafting]]: Dust and Ounces, Platings, and Trait Materials. Dust is the raw material that can be found in the world in jewelry crafting seams. By themselves they cannot be used, but they may be refined into Ounces at any jewelry crafting station. Unlocking the "Plentiful Harvest" and "Master Gatherer" perks in the Craft [[Online:Champion#Craft|Champion]] tree will also provide bonuses when harvesting. There is a small chance of producing platings when refining raw dust. The dust you find is determined by your character's level and your [[Online:Engraver|Engraving]] level—if you are level 40 with an Engraving level of 1, you will find both Pewter and Copper Dust out in the world. Ounces are used to make [[ON:Jewelry|Jewelry]], including Necklaces and Rings. Platings can be used to improve existing jewelry. They can be obtained by deconstructing existing jewelry pieces. Ounces and platings can be obtained as rewards for completing [[Online:Jewelry Crafting Writ|Jewelry Crafting Writs]]. Trait Materials (once refined from their Pulverized form) are used to craft jewelry with traits, provided that trait has been researched on that piece. Every trait material is acquired through different means, though all of them have a chance to drop when deconstructing jewelry pieces that have traits. Prior to [[Online:Update 40|Update 40]], Dust nodes also dropped materials called Grains, which could be refined to Plating the same way Dust is refined to Ounces. In an order to rebalance the Jewelry Crafting system, the game developers completely removed Grains from the game. All Grains in players' inventories were replaced with Platings, and they were given 10 Platings for every original Plating. Online:Sapiarchs:
<noinclude>{{Trail|Factions}}{{Mod Header|Summerset}}{{TOCright}}</noinclude>
The [[Online:Sapiarchs|Sapiarchs]] are a group of [[ON:Altmer|Altmeri]] mages and scholars found throughout [[ON:Summerset|Summerset Isle]], particularly at the [[ON:College of Sapiarchs|College of Sapiarchs]] and the [[ON:Crystal Tower|Crystal Tower]], of which they are the keepers of. They are deeply ingrained in the Isle's society, as they even hold political power, considering the Sapiarchs have served and continue to serve as the advisors to the rulers in [[ON:Alinor|Alinor]].<noinclude>

The Sapiarchs play a key role in the main questline of the [[Online:Summerset (Chapter)|Summerset]] chapter.

There is also a [[ON:Styles|style]] associated with this faction, the [[ON:Sapiarch Style|Sapiarch Style]]. Chapters of this style book can be found by completing [[ON:Repeatable Quests|repeatable quests]] for the [[ON:Divine Prosecution|Divine Prosecution]]. Crafting Sapiarch Style items requires {{icon|style material|Culanda Lacquer|18}}'''[[ON:Culanda Lacquer|{{ESO Quality Color|n|Culanda Lacquer}}]]'''.
